a: Benizke mamono, vesiyyem benizke gufo; lomar lecha: ishsho mishshum chitztzav.
Amar rava, kashya leh leabbaye: leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav, tamun baesh diftar rachamana – hechi mashkachat la?
Venicha leh: kegon shennafla deleka leoto chatzer, venafla gader shello mechamat deleka, vehalcha vehidlika vehizzika bechatzer acheret. dehatam – kelu leh chitztzav.
I hachi, leinyan galuy name kelu leh chitztzav!
Ella leman deit leh mishshum chitztzav – it leh name mishshum mamono; uchegon shehaya lo legodrah velo gedarah; dehatam – shoro hu vela tefach beappeh.
Vechi meachar deman deit leh mishshum chitztzav it leh name mishshum mamono, may benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu lechayyeyvo bearbaa devarim.
Al hacharara meshallem kulei. man chayyayv – baal kelev. velichayyayv name baal gachelet! besheshshimmer gachalto.
I kesheshshimmer gachalto, may bae kelev hatam? beshechatar. amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: zot omeret, setam delatot chaturot hen etzel kelev.
Deachla hecha? illema deachla begadish dealma, ha baenan "uvier bisde acher", velekka! la tzericha, deachla begadish devaal charara.
Tifshot defi fara –
b: Kachatzar hannizzak dame; dei kachatzar hammazzik dame, lema leh: may bae riftach befumma dechalbay?
Deibbaya lehu: pi fara – kachatzar hannizzak dame, o kachatzar hammazzik dame?
Vei amrat kachatzar hammazzik dame, shen dechayyev rachamana hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: kegon shennitchakkecha bechotel lahanaatah, vetinnefa perot lahanaatah.
Matkef la mar zutera: veha baena "kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo", velekka! ravina amar: deshaf tzalme, rav ashe amar: defassaoy passoe.
Ta shema: shissa bo et hakkelev, shissa bo et hannachash – patur. man patur – meshasse patur, vechayyayv baal kelev; vei amrat kachatzar hammazzik dame, lema leh: may bae yedach befummeh dechalbay?
Ema: patur af meshasse. veibbaet ema: deappekeh leniveh vesarteh.
Ta shema: hishshich bo et hannachash – rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrim.

Veamar rav acha bar yaakov: keshettimtze lomar; ledivre rabbi yehuda, eres nachash – ben shinnav hu omed, lefichach makkish besayif, venachash patur. ledivre chachamim, eres nachash – meatzmo mikki, lefichach nachash biskila, umakkish patur.
Vei amrat pi fara kachatzar hammazzik dame, lema leh: may bae yedach befumma dechivvavy? leinyan ketala la amrinan.
Umena temra? detanya: hannichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit, umet – hashshor biskila, uvealim peturim min hakkofer.
Bealim peturin min hakkofer may tama – deamar leh: birshuti may baet; shoro name, lema leh: may baet birshuti! ella leinyan ketala la amrinan.
Hanhu izze deve tarbu dahavo mafsedi leh lerav yosef, amar leh leabbaye: zil ema lehu lemarayyhu delaytzneinhu. amar leh: ammay ezil? dei azelna, amri li: ligdor mar gedera beareh.
Vei gadar, shen dechayyev rachamana hechi mashkachat la? keshechatra. i name, denafel gudda belelya.

Machrez rav yosef veittema rabba: desalkin leella udenachatin letachta – hane izze deshuka demafsedi, matrenan bemarayyhu tere utelata zimnin. i tzayet – tzayet. vei la – amrinan leh: tiv ammesachta vekabbel zuzach.

Mishna ezehu tam veezehu muad? muad – kol sheheidu bo shelosha yamim, vetam – mishsheyyachzor bo shelosha yamim; divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: muad – sheheidu bo shelosha peamim, vetam – kol sheyyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach.
Gemara may tama derabbi yehuda? amar abbaye: "temol" – chad; "mittemol" – tere; "shilshom" – telata; "velo yishmerennu bealav" – atan lingicha reviit.
Rava amar: "temol–mittemol" – chad; "shilshom" – tere; "vela yishmerennu" haiddana – chayyayv.
Verabbi meir, may tama? detanya, amar rabbi meir:

a: Richek negichotav – chayyayv; kerav negichotav lo kol shekken?! amaru leh: zava tochiach, sherichaka reiyyoteha – temea, kerva reiyyoteha – tehora!
Amar lahen, hare hu omer: "vezot tihye tumato bezovo" – tala hakkatuv et hazzav biriyyot, veet hazzava beyamim.
Mimmay dehay "vezot" – lemaote zava meriyyot? ema lemaote zav miyyamim! amar kera: "vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva" – makkish zachar linkeva; ma nekeva beyamim, af zachar beyamim.
Velakkesh nekeva lezachar – ma zachar biriyyot, af nekeva biriyyot! ha mayet rachamana "vezot".
Uma raita? mistabbera, kae biriyyot – memaet reiyyot; kae biriyyot – memaet yamim?!

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu muad – kol sheheidu bo shelosha yamim; vetam – sheyyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach; divre rabbi yose. rabbi shimon omer: muad – kol sheheidu bo shalosh peamim, velo amru shelosha yamim ella lachazara bilvad.
Amar rav nachman amar rav adda bar ahava: halacha kerabbi yehuda bemuad, shehare rabbi yose mode lo; vahalacha kerabbi meir betam, shehare rabbi yose mode lo.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: velema mar halacha kerabbi meir bemuad, shehare rabbi shimon mode lo; vahalacha kerabbi yehuda betam, shehare rabbi shimon mode lo! amar leh: ana kerabbi yose sevira li, derabbi yose nimmuko immo.
Ibbaya lehu: "shelosha yamim" dekatane – leyayode tora, o leyayode gavra?
Lemay nafka minna? deatu telata kitte sahadi bechad yoma. i amrat leyayode tora, miyyayad; vei amrat leyayode gavra, la miyyayad – memar amar: hasheta hu dekamashadu bi. may?

Ta shema: en hashshor naase muad, ad sheyyaidu bo bifne vealim uvifne vet din. heidu bo bifne vet din veshello bifne vealim, bifne vealim veshello bifne vet din – eno naase muad, ad sheyyaidu bo bifne vet din uvifne vealim.
Heiduhu shenayim barishona, ushenayim bashsheniyya, ushenayim bashshelishit – hare kan shalosh ediyyot, vehen edut achat lahazama.
Nimtzet kat rishona zomemet – hare kan shete ediyyot, vehu patur vehen peturim. nimtzet kat sheniyya zomemet – hare kan edut achat, vehu patur vehen peturim.
Nimtzet kat shelishit zomemet – kullan chayyayvin. veal ze neemar: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam vegomer".
I amrat leyayode tora – shappir.
b: Ella i amrat leyayode gavra, lemru hanach kammae: anan mi hava yadinan devatar telata yome – atu hane umeyayadi leh?

Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana, vaamar li: uleyayode tora mi nicha?! velemru hanach batrae: anan mena yadinan dechol dekae be dina – leashode betora kaatu? anan lechayyove gavra palga nizka atenan!
Dekamrammezi rammoze. rav ashe amar: keshebbau retzufim.
Ravina amar: bemakkirin baal hashshor, veen makkirin et hashshor.
Ella hechi meyayadi leh? deamri: tora naggechana it lach bevakrach, ibbei lach lenattore lechulleh bakra.

Ibbaya lehu: hameshasse kalbo shel chavero bachavero, mahu? meshasse – vadday patur; baal kelev – may? mi amrinan matze amar leh: ana – may avedna leh? o dilma, amrinan leh: kevan deyadat bechalbach dimshasse leh umishtasse, la ibbei lach leashhoyeh?

Amar rabbi zera, ta shema: vetam – sheyyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo, veeno nogeach. ha nogeach – chayyayv! amar abbaye, mi katane: nagach chayyayv? dilma ha nagach – la have tam; uvehahi negicha la michayyayv.
Ta shema: shissa bo et hakkelev, shissa bo nachash – patur. may, lav patur meshasse, vechayyayv baal kelev? la; ema: patur af meshasse.
Amar rava, im timtze lomar: hameshasse kalbo shel chavero bachavero – chayyayv; shissahu hu beatzmo – patur. may tama? kol hameshanne, uva acher veshinna bo – patur.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: ittemar mishshemeh deresh lakish kevotaych – deamar resh lakish: shete parot birshut harabbim, achat revutza veachat mehallechet, uviata mehallechet birvutza – petura. revutza bimhallechet – chayyevet.
Amar leh: ana – behahi chayyove mechayyevna, deamrinan leh: ki it lach reshuta – lesaggoye alay; levaote bi let lach reshuta.

Mishna shor hammazzik birshut hannizzak, ketzad? nagach, nagaf, nashach, ravatz, baat; birshut harabbim – meshallem chatzi nezek. birshut hannizzak – rabbi tarfon omer: nezek shalem, vachachamim omrim: chatzi nezek.

Amar lahem rabbi tarfon: uma bemakom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel – birshut harabbim, shehu patur; hechmir alehen birshut hannizzak – leshallem nezek shalem; mekom shehechmir al hakkeren – birshut harabbim, leshallem chatzi nezek; eno din shennachmir alav birshut hannizzak – leshallem nezek shalem?
Amru lo: dayyo labba min haddin – lihyot kanniddon. ma birshut harabbim – chatzi nezek, af birshut hannizzak – chatzi nezek.
Amar lahem: af ani

a: Lo adun keren mikkeren, ani adun keren meregel – uma bemakom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel, birshut harabbim – hechmir bakkeren; makom shehechmir al hashshen veal haregel, birshut hannizzak – eno din shennachmir bakkeren?
Amru lo: dayyo labba min haddin – lihyot kanniddon. ma birshut harabbim – chatzi nezek, af birshut hannizzak – chatzi nezek.

Gemara verabbi tarfon let leh dayyo?! veha dayyo deorayyta hu! detanya: middin kal vechomer – ketzad? "vayyomer Adonai el moshe: veaviha yarok yarak befaneha, halo tikkalem shivat yamim?!" – kal vechomer lashshechina, arbaa asar yom! ella dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.

Ki let leh dayyo – hecha demipperich kal vachomer; hecha dela mipperich kal vachomer – it leh dayyo. hatam – shiva dishchina la ketivi; ata kal vachomer ayyti arbesar, ata dayyo appek shiva, veoke shiva.
Aval hacha – chatzi nezek ketiv; vaata kal vachomer veayyti chatzi nezek acharina, venaasa nezek shalem; i darshat dayyo – ipperich leh kal vachomer!
Verabbanan, shiva dishchina ketivi – "tissager shivat yamim".
Verabbi tarfon, hahu "tissager" – dedarshinan dayyo hu.
Verabbanan, ketiv kera acharina – "vattissager miryam". verabbi tarfon, hahu – daafillu bealma darshinan dayyo, velo tomar: hacha – mishshum kevodo shel moshe, aval bealma la; ka mashma lan.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veha hay tanna, dela daresh dayyo, veaf al gav dela mipperich kal vachomer! detanya: keri bezav minnayin? vedin hu, ma tahor betahor – tame betame; tame betahor – eno din sheyyehe tame betame?
Veka mayyte la ben lemagga ben lemassa. veammay? nema: ahani kal vachomer lemagga, ahani dayyo leappoke massa!

Vechi tema: lemagga la itzterich kal vachomer, dela gara miggavra tahor; itzterich, salka datach amena: "mikkere layla" ketiv – mi shekkiryo gorem lo; yatza ze, sheen kiryo gorem lo – ella davar acher garam lo; ka mashma lan.
Midde "velo davar acher" ketiv?!

Uman tanna deshamat leh deamar: shichvat zera shel zav metammea bemassa? la rabbi eliezer, vela rabbi yehoshua. ditnan: shichvat zera shel zav metammea bemagga, veen metammea bemassa; divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua omer: af metammea bemassa, lefi shei efshar belo tzichtzuche ziva.
Ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam – ella shei efshar belo tzichtzuche ziva, ha lav hachi – la! ella hay tanna hu – ditnan: lemala mehen
b: Zovo shel zav, verukko, veshichvat zaro, umeme raglav, vedam hannidda – metammein ben bemagga ben bemassa.
Vedilma hachi name – lefi shei efshar belo tzichtzuche ziva! im ken, litneyay gabbe zovo; may shena dekatane la gabbe rukko? ella mishshum deate merukko.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: veha hay tanna la daresh dayyo, veaf al gav dela mipperich kal vachomer! detanya: mappatz bemet minnayin? vedin hu, uma pakkin ketannim – shettehorim bezav, metamme bemet; mappatz – shemmetamme bezav, eno din sheyyetamme bemet?
Vekamayyte la ben letumeat erev, ben letumeat shiva. veammay? ema: ahani kal vachomer letumeat erev, veahani dayyo leappoke tumeat shiva!

Amar leh: kevar rema nihaleh rav nachman bar zecharya leabbaye, vaamar leh abbaye: tanna – mimmappatz besheretz mayyte la, vehachi kaamar: mappatz besheretz minnayin? vedin hu, uma pakkin ketannim – shettehorim bezav, temein besheretz; mappatz – shettame bezav, eno din sheyyehe tame besheretz?
Ella mappatz bemet minnayin? neemar "beged vaor" besheretz, veneemar "beged vaor" bemet; ma "beged vaor" haamur besheretz – mappatz tame bo, af "beged vaor" haamur bemet – mappatz tame bo.
Mufene; dei la mufene, ikka lemifrach: ma lesheretz – shekken metamme bechaadasha, tomar bemet – sheen metamme bechaadasha, ella bichzayit.

Laye ippenoye mufene – mikkede sheretz ittakkash leshichvat zera, dichtiv: "o ish asher tetze vegomer", usemich leh: "o ish asher yigga bechol sheretz"; uchetiv beh beshichvat zera: "vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara".
"Beged vaor" dichtav rachamana besheretz – lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti mufene mitztzad echad hu! hanicha leman deamar mufene mitztzad echad – lemedin veen meshivin, shappir; ella leman deamar lemedin umeshivin, may ikka lememar?

Demet name ippenoye mufene – mikkede met ittakkash leshichvat zera, dichtiv: "vehannogea bechol teme nefesh, o ish asher tetze mimmennu vegomer"; uchetiv beh beshichvat zera: "vechol beged vechol or asher yihye alav shichvat zara"; "beged vaor" dichtav rachamana bemet – lema li? shema minna leafnoye, vehave mufene mishshene tzedadin.
Hanicha leman deamar: dun minna – veoke beatra; ella leman deamar: dun minna uminna, may ikka lememar?
Amar rava, amar kera: "vechibbastem bigdechem bayyom hashshevii" – kol temaot sheattem mittammein bemet, lo yehu pechutin mishshiva.

Utehe shen varegel chayyayv birshut harabbim mikkal vachomer – uma keren, shebbirshut hannizzak eno meshallem ella chatzi nezek – birshut harabbim chayyevet; shen varegel, shebbirshut hannizzak meshallem nezek shalem – eno din shebbirshut harabbim chayyayv?
Amar kera: "uvier bisde acher" – velo birshut harabbim.

a: Midde kulleh kaamrinan?! palga kaamrinan!
Amar kera: "vechatzu et kaspo" – kaspo shel ze, velo kaspo shel acher.

Velo tehe shen varegel chayyevet birshut hannizzak ella chatzi nezek – mikkal vachomer mikkeren; uma keren, shebbirshut harabbim chayyevet – birshut hannizzak enah meshallemet ella chatzi nezek; shen varegel, shebbirshut harabbim petura – eno din shebbirshut hannizzak meshallem chatzi nezek?
Amar kera: "yeshallem" – tashlumin mealleya.

Velo tehe keren birshut harabbim chayyayv – mikkal vachomer; uma shen varegel, shebbirshut hannizzak nezek shalem – birshut harabbim petura; keren, shebbirshut hannizzak chatzi nezek – eno din shebbirshut harabbim petura?
Amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "yechetzun" – en chatzi nezek chaluk lo birshut harabbim velo birshut hayyachid.
Vihe adam chayyayv bechofer – mikkal vachomer; uma shor, sheeno chayyayv bearbaa devarim – chayyayv bechofer; adam, shechayyayv bearbaa devarim – eno din sheyyehe chayyayv bechofer?
Amar kera: "kechol asher yushat alav"; "alav" – velo al adam.
Vihe shor chayyayv bearbaa devarim – mikkal vechomer; uma adam, sheeno chayyayv bechofer – chayyayv bearbaa devarim; shor, shechayyayv bechofer – eno din sheyyehe chayyayv bearbaa devarim?
Amar kera: "ish baamito" – velo shor baamito.

Ibbaya lehu: regel sheddarsa al gabbe tinok bachatzar hannizzak, mahu shetteshallem kofer? mi amrinan: midde dehave akkeren – keren, kevan daavad tere utelata zimne – orcheh hu, umeshallem kofer; hacha name la shena;
O dilma, keren kauonato lehazzik, hay en kauonato lehazzik?
Ta shema: hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, unegacho levaal habbayit vamet; hashshor – biskila, uvealav – ben tam ben muad, meshallem kofer shalem; divre rabbi tarfon.

Kofer shalem betam, lerabbi tarfon – mena leh? lav mishshum desavar leh kerabbi yose haggelili, deamar: tam meshallem chatzi chofer birshut harabbim – umayyte la mikkal vachomer meregel? alma ikka kofer beregel!
Amar rav shimi minnehardea: tanna – minnezakin deregel mayyte la.
Velifroch: ma linzakin deregel – shekken yeshnan beesh! mittamun.
Ma letamun – shekken yeshno bevor! mikkelim.
Ma lechelim – sheyyeshnan beesh! mikkelim temunim. ma lechelim temunim – sheyyeshnan beadam!
Ella lav shema minna mikkofer deregel mayyte la? alma ikka kofer beregel! shema minna.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: hachi name mistabbera – deikka kofer beregel; dei salka datach lekka kofer beregel – vetanna minnezakin deregel mayyte la, lifroch: ma linzakin deregel – shekken yeshnan beregel!
Ella lav shema minna mikkofer deregel mayyte la? alma ikka kofer beregel! shema minna.
Mishna adam muad leolam – ben shogeg ben mezid, ben er ben yashen. simme et en chavero veshibber et hakkelim – meshallem nezek shalem.
Gemara katane "simme et en chavero" dumeya deshibber et hakkelim"; ma hatam – nezek in, arbaa devarim la; af simme et en chavero – nezek in, arbaa devarim la.
b: Mena hane mille? amar chizkiyya, vechen tana deve chizkiyya, amar kera: "petza tachat patza" – lechayyeyvo al hashshogeg kemezid, veal haones keratzon.
Hay mibbee leh litten tzaar bimkom nezek! im ken, lichtov kera: "petza befatza"; may "tachat patza" – shema minna tarte.

Amar rabba: hayta even munnachat lo becheko velo hikkir bah, veamad venafla; leinyan nezakin – chayyayv, leinyan arbaa devarim – patur, leinyan shabbat – melechet machshevet asra tora, leinyan galut – patur,
Leinyan eved – pelugeta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan. detanya: hare shehaya rabbo rofe, veamar lo: "kechol eni", vesimmeah; "chator li shinni", vehippilah – sichek baadon, veyatza lecherut.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: "veshichatah" – ad sheyyitkavven leshachatah.

Hikkir bah ushechechah, veamad venafla; leinyan nezakin – chayyayv. leinyan arbaa devarim – patur. leinyan galut – chayyayv, deamar kera: "bishgaga" – mikkelal dahava leh yedia, veha haveya leh yedia. leinyan shabbat – patur. leinyan eved – pelugeta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan.

Nitkavven lizrok shetayim, vezarak arba; leinyan nezakin – chayyayv. leinyan arbaa devarim – patur. leinyan shabbat – melechet machshevet baenan. leinyan galut – "asher lo tzada" amar rachamana, perat lenitkavven lizrok shetayim vezarak arba. leinyan eved – pelugeta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan.

Nitkavven lizrok arba, vezarak shemone; leinyan nezakin – chayyayv. leinyan arbaa devarim – patur. leinyan shabbat – beomer "kol makom shettirtze tanuach", in; i la, la. leinyan galut – "asher lo tzada", perat lenitkavven lizrok arba vezarak shemone. leinyan eved – pelugeta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan.
Veamar rabba: zarak keli merosh haggag, uva acher ushevaro bemakkel – patur. may tama? mana tevira tavar.
Veamar rabba: zarak keli merosh haggag, vehayu tachtav karim o chesatot; ba acher vesillekan, o kadam [hu] vesillekan – patur. may tama? beiddana deshadyeh – passoke mefasseki gireh.

Veamar rabba: zarak tinok merosh haggag, uva acher vekibbelo besayif – pelugeta derabbi yehuda ben betera verabbanan. detanya: hikkuhu asara bene adam baasara maklot – ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze, kullan

a: Peturin. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: beze achar ze – haacharon chayyayv, mippene shekkerav mitato.

Ba shor vekibbelo bekarnav – pelugeta derabbi yishmael beno shel yochanan ben beroka verabbanan, detanya: "venatan pidyon nafsho" – deme nizzak. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: deme mazzik.
Veamar rabba: nafal merosh haggag venitka beishsha – chayyayv bearbaa devarim. uvivimto – lo kana.
Chayyayv benezek, betzaar, berippuy, beshevet. aval boshet – la, ditnan: eno chayyayv al habboshet ad sheyyehe mitkavven.

Veamar rabba: nafal merosh haggag beruach sheenah metzuya, vehizzik uviyyesh – chayyayv al hannezek, ufatur bearbaa devarim. beruach metzuya, vehizzik uviyyesh – chayyayv bearbaa devarim, ufatur al habboshet. veim nithappech – chayyayv af al habboshet.
Detanya: mimmashma shenneemar "veshalcha yadah" – eni yodea shehechezika?! ma talmud lomar "vehechezika"? lomar lecha: kevan shennitkavven lehazzik – af al pi shello nitkavven levayyesh.
Veamar rabba: hinniach lo gachelet al libbo, vamet – patur. al bigdo, venisraf – chayyayv.

Amar rava: tarvayyhu tenanhi. al libbo – ditnan: kavash alav letoch haur o letoch hammayim, veeno yachol laalot mishsham, vamet – chayyayv. dechafo letoch haur o letoch hammayim, veyachol laalot mishsham, vamet – patur.
Bigdo – ditnan: "kera et kesuti", "shabber et kaddi" – chayyayv. "al menat liftor" – patur.
Bae rabba: hinniach gachelet al lev avdo, mahu? kegufo dame, o kemamono dame? im timtza lomar kegufo dame, shoro mahu?
Hadar pashta: avdo kegufo, shoro kemamono.
Hadaran alach ketzad haregel
Mishna hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim, uva acher venitkal bah ushevarah – patur. veim huzzak bah – baal hechavit chayyayv benizko.
Gemara patach bechad, vesiyyem bechavit!
Utenan name: ze ba bechavito veze ba bekorato, nishbera kaddo shel ze bekorato shel ze – patur. patach bechavit, vesiyyem bechad!

Utenan name: ze ba bechavito shel yayin, veze ba bechaddo shel devash; nisdeka chavit shel devash, veshafach ze yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letocho – en lo ella secharo. patach bechad, vesiyyem bechavit!
Amar rav pappa: hayeynu kad – hayeynu chavit. lemay nafka minna? lemikkach umimkar.
Hechi dame? illema beatra dechadda la karu "chavit", vechavit la karu "kadda"; ha la karu la!
La tzericha, derubba karu la lechadda "kadda" ulechavita "chavita", veikka name dekaru lechavita "kadda" ulechadda "chavita"; mahu detema: zil batar rubba,
b: Ka mashma lan deen holchin bemamon achar harov.
Uva acher venitkal bah ushevarah – patur. ammay patur? ibbei leh leayyone umezal!
Amri deve rav mishshemeh derav: bimmalle reshut harabbim kullah chaviyyot. shemuel amar: baafela shanu. rabbi yochanan amar: bekeren zavit.
Amar rav pappa: la dayka matnitin ella o kishmuel, o kerabbi yochanan. dei kerav, may irya nitkal? afillu shavar name!

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: hu haddin daafillu shavar; vehay dekatane "nitkal" – ayyeyde devae lemitne sefa: "veim huzzak bah – baal chavit chayyayv benizko", dedavka nitkal, aval shavar – la, may tama? hu deazzek annafsheh; katane resha "nitkal".
Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe, hachi amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi ulla: lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitbonen badderachim.
Hava ovada binhardea, vechayyev shemuel. befumebdita, vechayyev rava.
Bishlama shemuel – kishmateh. ella rava – lema kishmuel sevira leh?
Amar rav pappa: karna deatzra have, dechevan devirshut kaavdi – ibbei leh leayyone umezal.
Shelach leh rav chisda lerav nachman, hare amru: lirchubba – shalosh, velivita – chamesh, velisnokeret – shelosh esre. lefanda demara ulekofina demara, may?
Shelach leh: chisda chisda, kenasa ka magbet bevavel? ema li gufa deovada hechi hava.
Shelach leh: dehahu garguta deve tere, dechol yoma hava dale chad minnayyhu. ata chad, ka dale beyoma dela dileh. amar leh: yoma didi hu! la ashgach beh. shekal panda demara, machyeh.
Amar leh: mea pande befanda limchayeh! afillu leman deamar: la aved inish dina lenafsheh; bimkom peseda – aved inish dina lenafsheh.
Deittemar, rav yehuda amar: la aved inish dina lenafsheh. rav nachman amar: aved inish dina lenafsheh.

Hecha deikka peseda – kulle alma la peligi, deaved inish dina lenafsheh. ki peligi – hecha delekka peseda; rav yehuda amar: la aved inish dina lenafsheh, dechevan delekka peseda – lezil kammeh dayyayna. rav nachman amar: aved inish dina lenafsheh, dechevan divdin aved – la tarach.
Metiv rav kahana, ben bag bag omer: al tikkanes lachatzar chavercha littol et shellecha shello birshut, shemma terae alav kegannav. ella shevor et shinnav, veemor lo: shelli ani notel.
Amar leh:

a: Immach?! ben bag bag yechidaa hu, ufeligi rabbanan aleh.
Rabbi yannay amar: may "shevor et shinnav" – baddin.
I hachi, "veemor lo"?! "veomrim lo" mibbee leh! "shelli ani notel"?! "shello hu notel" mibbee leh! kashya.
Ta shema: shor sheala al gabbe chavero lehorgo, uva baal hattachton veshamat et shello, venafal elyon vamet – patur. may, lav bemuad – delekka peseda?
La, betam – deikka peseda.
I hachi, ema sefa: dechafo laelyon vamet – chayyayv. vei betam, ammay chayyayv?
Shehaya lo leshomto, velo shemato.
Ta shema: hamemalle chatzar chavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen – baal hechatzer meshabber veyotze, meshabber venichnas!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: meshabber veyotze levet din, meshabber venichnas lehavi zechiyyotav.
Ta shema: minnayin lenirtza shekkalu lo yamav, verabbo mesarhev bo latzet, vechaval veasa bo chabbura, shehu patur –
Talmud lomar: "lo tikkechu chofer" "lashuv" – lo tikchu kofer lashshav!
Hacha bemay askinan – beavda gannava.
Ad haiddana la genav, vehasheta ganev?! ad haiddana hava emteh derabbeh aleh, hasheta let leh emta derabbeh aleh.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: beeved shemmasar lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit; ad haiddana hettera, vehasheta issura.
Ta shema: hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim, uva acher venitkal bah ushevarah – patur. tama denitkal bah, ha shevarah – chayyayv!

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: hu haddin afillu shevarah; vehay dekatane "nitkal" – ayyeyde dekavae lemitne sefa: im huzzak – baal chavit chayyayv benizko, dedavka nitkal aval shavar la, dehu azzek nafsheh; katane resha nitkal.
Ta shema: "vekatztzota et kappah" – mamon. may, lav besheenah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher? lo, sheyyechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher.

Aval enah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher – petura? i hachi, addetane sefa: "veshalcha yadah" – perat lishliach bet din; liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – besheyyechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher, aval enah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher – petura!
Hachi name kaamar: bamme devarim amurim – besheyyechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher, aval enah yechola lehatztzil al yede davar acher – naasa yadah kishliach bet din, ufetura.
Ta shema: hare shehayta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu; netalah, venatan lahem min hatztzad – ma shennatan natan, veshello lo higgio.
Vei amrat aved inish dina lenafsheh, linkot pazra velitev!
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: gezera shemma yitten lahem derech akallaton.
Rav mesharsheya amar: benoten lahem derech akallaton.
Rav ashe amar: kol min hatztzad – derech akallaton hu, kerova laze urechoka laze.
I hachi, ammay shello lo higgio? lema lehu: shekulu didchu, vehavu li didi!
Mishshum derav yehuda – deamar rav yehuda: metzar shehecheziku bo rabbim – asur lekalkelo.
Ta shema: baal habbayit shehinniach pea mitztzad echad, uvau aniyyim venatlu mitztzad acher – ze vaze pea. vei amrat aved inish dina lenafsheh, ammay ze vaze pea? linkot pazra velitev!
Amar rava: may "ze vaze pea" – lefotran min hammaaser.
Kidtanya: hammafkir et karmo, vehishkim babboker uvetzaro – chayyayv beferet uveolelot uveshichcha uvefea, ufatur min hammaaser.
Mishna nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim, vehuchelak echad bammayim o shellaka becharsit – chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: bemitkavven – chayyayv, beeno mitkavven – patur.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo shanu ella shettinnefu kelav bammayim,
b: Aval hu atzmo – patur; karka olam hizzikattu.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: mikkede avno vesakkino umassao – mibboro lamadnu, vechullan ani kore bahen: "shor" – velo adam, "chamor" – velo kelim.
Vehane mille leinyan ketala, aval leinyan nezakin – adam chayyayv, vechelim peturin.
Verav – hane mille hecha deafkerinhu, aval hecha dela afkerinhu – mamono hu.

Metiv rav oshaya: "venafal shamma shor o chamor"; "shor" – velo "adam", "chamor" – velo kelim. mikkan amru: nafal letocho shor vechelav venishtabberu, chamor vechelav venitkaru – chayyayv al habbehema, ufatur al hakkelim. ha lema ze dome – leavno vesakkino umassao shehinnichan birshut harabbim vehizziku.
Adderabba, "ma dome laze" mibbee leh! ella may dome laze – avno vesakkino umassao shehinnichan birshut harabbim vehizziku.
Lefichach, im hetiach tzelochito beeven – chayyayv.
Resha kashya lerav, vesefa kashya lishmuel!
Uletamaych, tikshe lach hi gufa – (kashya) resha patur, vesefa chayyayv!
Ella rav metaretz letameh, ushemuel metaretz letameh.
Rav metaretz letameh, bamme devarim amurim – keshehifkiran, aval lo hifkiran – chayyayv. lefichach hetiach tzelochito beeven – chayyayv.
Ushemuel metaretz letameh, hasheta deamrat avno sakkino umassao – kevoro dame; lerabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke chelim bevor, lefichach hetiach tzelochito beeven – chayyayv.
Amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella shennitkal baeven, venishshof baeven. aval nitkal bakkarka venishshof baeven – patur.
Keman – dela kerabbi natan.

Ikka deamri, amar rabbi elazar: la tema benitkal baeven venishshof baeven hu demichayyayv, aval nitkal bakkarka venishshof baeven – patur; ella afillu nitkal bakkarka venishshof baeven – chayyayv. keman – kerabbi natan.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bemitkavven chayyayv vechulei. hechi dame mitkavven?
Amar rabba: bemitkavven lehoridah lematta mikketefo. amar leh abbaye: mikkelal dimchayyev rabbi meir afillu nifshera? amar leh: in, mechayyev haya rabbi meir afillu oznah beyado.
Ammay? anus hu, veones rachamana patreh – dichtiv: "velannaara lo taase davar"!
Vechi tema hane mille leinyan ketala, aval leinyan nezakin – chayyayv; vehatanya: nishbera kaddo velo sillekah, nafla gemallo velo heemida – rabbi meir mechayyev behezzekan, vachachamim omrim:

a: Patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim.

Umodim chachamim lerabbi meir, beavno sakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo, venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku – shehu chayyayv. umode rabbi meir lerabbanan, bemaale kankannin al haggag al menat lenaggevan, venaflu beruach sheenah metzuya vehizziku – shehu patur.
Ella amar abbaye: betarte peligi; peligi bishat nefila, ufeligi leachar nefila.
Peligi bishat nefila – benitkal poshea. mar savar: nitkal poshea hu, umar savar: nitkal lav poshea hu.
Peligi leachar nefila – bemafkir nezakav; mar savar: mafkir nezakav chayyayv, umar savar: patur.
Umimmay? middekatane tarte: huchelak echad bammayim, o shellaka bacharsit. hayeynu hach! ella lav hachi kaamar – huchelak echad bammayim bishat nefila, o shellaka bacharsit leachar nefila.
Umiddematnitin betarte, barayyta name betarte.
Bishlama kaddo – mashkachat la o bishat nefila, o leachar nefila. ella gemallo – bishlama leachar nefila, mashkachat la bemafkir nivlato. ella bishat nefila, hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav acha: kegon deabbera (bemayya) derech serata denahara.
Hechi dame? i deikka darka acharina – poshea hu! vei delekka darka acharina – anus hu!
Ella mashkachat la deittekil, veittekila beh gamla.
Mafkir nezakav – may mitkavven ikka?
Amar rav yosef: bemitkavven lizkot bacharaseha. vechen amar rav ashe: bemitkavven lizkot bacharaseha.
Rabbi elazar amar: bishat nefila machloket.
Aval leachar nefila may – divre hakkol patur? veha ikka rabbi meir dimchayyev! ella may – divre hakkol chayyayv? veha ikka rabbanan defatri!
Ella may "bishat nefila" – af bishat nefila, vekamashma lan kidabbaye.
b: Verabbi yochanan amar: leachar nefila machloket.
Aval bishat nefila may – divre hakkol patur? veha middekaamar rabbi yochanan lekamman: la tema matnitin rabbi meir hi, deamar nitkal poshea hu; mikkelal derabbi meir mechayyev!
Ella may – divre hakkol chayyayv? veha middekaamar rabbi yochanan lekamman: la tema matnitin rabbi meir hi, deamar nitkal poshea hu; mikkelal defatri rabbanan!
Ella ha ka mashma lan – demafkir nezakav dehacha hu defatri rabbanan, deanus hu; aval mafkir nezakav dealma – mechayyeyvi.
Ittemar: mafkir nezakav; rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar – chad amar: chayyayv, vechad amar: patur.
Lema man dimchayyev – kerabbi meir, uman defatar – kerabbanan?

Allibba derabbi meir – kulle alma la peligi, ki peligi – allibba derabbanan. man defatar – kerabbanan; uman dimchayyev amar lach: ana daamari – afillu lerabbanan, ad kan la patri rabbanan, ella bemafkir nezakav dehacha, mishshum deanus hu; aval mafkir nezakav dealma – mechayyeyvi.

Tistayyem derabbi elazar hu deamar chayyayv – deamar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi yishmael: shene devarim enan birshuto shel adam, vaasaan hakkatuv keillu hen birshuto; veellu hen: bor birshut harabbim, vechametz mishshesh shaot ulemala. tistayyem.

Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi? veha amar rabbi elazar ippecha! ditnan: hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko. veamar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella shennitkavven lizkot bahen, aval lo nitkavven lizkot bahen – patur. alma mafkir nezakav – patur!
Amar rav adda bar ahava: shehechzirah limkomah. amar ravina: mashal derav adda bar ahava lamma haddavar dome – lemotze bor megulle, vechissahu, vechazar vegillahu.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: mi dame?! hatam – la istalluk lehu maase rishon, hacha – istalluk lehu maase rishon.
Ha la dame ella lemotze bor megulla, utemamah vechazar vachafarah – deistalliku lehu maase rishon, vekayyma la birshuto!
Ella amar rav ashe: keshehafachah lefachot mishshelosha.

Umay duchekeh derabbi elazar leokomay kegon shehafachah lefachot mishshelosha – vetama dechi nitkavven lizkot bah, ha en mitkavven lizkot bah – la? lokma lemala mishshelosha, veaf al gav dela nitkavven lizkot bah – chayyayv!
Amar rava: matnitin keshiteh – may irya "hafach"? litne "higbiah"! ella shema minna, kol "hafach" – lematta mishshelosha hu.
Umidderabbi elazar amar chayyayv, rabbi yochanan amar patur.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?! vehatnan: hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit; vehaggoder gedero bekotzim; vegader shennafal lirshut harabbim; vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella bemafriach, aval bimtzamtzem – patur. metzamtzem may tama patur – lav mishshum dehavya leh bor birshuto? mikkelal dechiyyuva devor – birshut harabbim hu; alma mafkir nezakav chayyayv!
La, leolam ema lach: mafkir nezakav patur; umetzamtzem may tama patur – mishshum deittemar ala, amar rav acha bereh derav ika: lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: hachofer bor birshut harabbim, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet – chayyayv!
Ella leolam rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv.
Umidderabbi yochanan amar chayyayv – rabbi elazar amar patur?! vehaamar rabbi elazar

a: Mishshum rabbi yishmael kulei!
La kashya; ha dideh. ha derabbeh.

Mishna hashshofech mayim birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko. hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit; vehaggoder et gedero bekotzim; vegader shennafal lirshut harabbim; vehuzzeku bahen acherim – chayyayv benizkan.
Gemara amar rav: lo shanu ella denitnefu kelav bemayim, aval hu atzmo – patur; karka olam hizzikattu.
Amar leh rav huna lerav: lo yehe ella kerifsho!
Mi savrat dela tammu mayya?! bidtammu mayya.
Vetarte lema li?
Chada bimot hachamma, vachada bimot haggeshamim.
Detanya: kol ellu sheamru potkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen – bimot hachamma en lahen reshut, uvimot haggeshamim yesh lahem reshut. veaf al pi shebbirshut – im hizziku, chayyayvin leshallem.

Hammatznia et hakkotz [vechulei]. amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella mafriach, aval metzamtzem la. may tama patur? amar rav acha bereh derav ika: lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim.
Tanu rabbanan: hammatznia kotzotav uzechuchiyyotav letoch kotel shel chavero, uva baal kotel vesatar kotlo venafal lirshut harabbim, vehizziku – chayyayv hammatznia.
Amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella bechotel raua, aval bechotel bari – hammatznia patur, vechayyayv baal hakkotel.
Amar ravina, zot omeret: hamechassa boro bedolyo shel chavero, uva baal deli venatal dolyo – chayyayv baal habbor.
Peshita!
Mahu detema: hatam hu dela havi yada leh – delodeh; aval hacha, deyada leh, hava leh leodoeh; ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: chasidim harishonim hayu matzniim kotzotehem uzechuchiyyotehem betoch sedotehen, umaamikim lahen shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha.
Rav sheshet shade lehu benura. rava shade lehu bediglat.
Amar rav yehuda: hay man devae lemeheve chasida – lekayyem mille dinzikin. rava amar: mille deavot. veamri la: mille divrachot.

Mishna hammotzi et tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol hamekalkelin birshut harabbim vehizziku – chayyayvin leshallem, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha.
Hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda?

Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bishat hotzaat zevalim, adam motzi zivlo lirshut harabbim vetzovro kol sheloshim yom, kede sheyyehe nishshof beragle adam uveragle behema. sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua et haaretz.
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda, mode rabbi yehuda sheim hizzik – meshallem ma shehizzik.
Vehatnan, rabbi yehuda omer: bener chanukka – patur, mippene shehu birshut. may, lav mishshum reshut bet din?
La, mishshum reshut mitzva. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bener chanukka – patur, mippene shehu reshut mitzva.
Ta shema: kol ellu sheamru muttarin lekalkel birshut harabbim – im hizziku, chayyayvin leshallem; verabbi yehuda poter!
Amar rav nachman: matnitin – shello bishat hotzaat zevalim, verabbi yehuda hi.
Rav ashe amar:
b: "Tivno vekashsho" tenan, mishshum demashreki.
Kol hakkodem bahen zacha. amar rav: ben begufan, ben beshivchan. uzeeri amar: beshivchan aval lo begufan.
Bemay kamippalgi? rav savar: kansu gufan mishshum shivchan, uzeeri savar: lo kansu gufan mishshum shivchan.
Tenan: hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko. veillu "kol hakkodem zacha" la katane!
Tena leresha, vehu haddin lesefa.
Veha tane ala: asurin mishshum gazel!
Ki katane "asurin mishshum gazel" – akkulla matnitin kae, leoto shekkadam vezacha.

Veha la katane hachi, ditnan: hammotzi tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha, umuttar mishshum gazel. vehahofech et haggalal lirshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv, veasur mishshum gazel!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: galal karamet?! davar sheyyesh bo shevach – kansu gufo mishshum shivcho, davar sheen bo shevach – lo kansu.
Ibbaya lehu: ledivre haomer kansu gufan mishshum shivchan; lealtar kansinan, o lechi mayyti shevacha kansinan?
Ta shema, middekaayyrinan galal!
Vetisbera?! ki ayyrinan galal – mikkamme dilshanne rav nachman; levatar deshanni rav nachman – mi ikka lemirme galal kelal?

Lema ketannae: shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit – konsin oto, veeno gove lo et hakkeren velo et haribbit; divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: gove et hakkeren, aval lo et haribbit. lema rav deamar kerabbi meir, uzeeri deamar kerabbanan?
Amar lecha rav: ana daamari – afillu lerabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella keren divhettera. aval hacha, keren gufa kamazzek.
Uzeeri amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerabbi meir – ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella demishsheat ketiva daavad leh suma; aval hacha – mi yemar demazzek?

Lema kehane tannae: hammotzi tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim, vehuzzak bahen acher – chayyayv benizko, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha, vaasurin mishshum gazel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol hamekalkelin birshut harabbim vehizziku – chayyayvin leshallem, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha, umuttarin mishshum gazel.

Ha gufa kashya – amrat kol hakkodem bahen zacha, vahadar kaamar asurin mishshum gazel! ella lav hachi kaamar: vechol hakkodem bahen zacha – beshivchan, vaasurin mishshum gazel – aggufan; vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar: afillu gufan name – kol hakkodem bahen zacha!
Lizeri – vadday tannae hi. lerav – mi lema tannae hi?

Amar lecha rav: dechulle alma – kansu gufan mishshum shivchan; vehacha, bahalacha veen morin ken ka mippalgi – deittemar, rav huna amar rav: halacha, veen morin ken. rav adda bar ahava amar: halacha, umorin ken.
Ini?! veha rav huna afkar chushele, rav adda bar ahava afkar

a: Selikuseta!
Bishlama rav adda bar ahava – kishmateh. ella rav huna, lema hadar beh?
Hanhu – muterin havo.
Mishna shene kaddarin shehayu mehallechin ze achar ze, venitkal harishon venafal, venitkal hashsheni barishon – harishon chayyayv benizke sheni.
Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: la tema matnitin rabbi meir hi, deamar: nitkal poshea hu – vechayyayv; ella afillu lerabbanan, deamri anus hu, ufatur – hacha chayyayv; shehaya lo laamod, velo amad.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: afillu tema lo haya lo laamod; haya lo lehazehir, velo hizhir.
Verabbi yochanan amar: kevan delo haya lo laamod – lo haya lo lehazehir; ditrid.
Tenan: haya baal kora rishon uvaal chavit acharon, nishbera chavit bakkora – patur, veim amad baal kora – chayyayv.
May, lav sheamad lechattef – deorcheh hu, vekatane chayyayv, dahava leh lehazehir?
Lo, kesheamad lafush.
Aval amad lechattef may, patur? addetane sefa: veim amar lo levaal chavit "amod" – patur, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – kesheamad lafush, aval amad lechattef – patur!
Ha ka mashma lan – deaf al gav deamad lafush, ki kaamar lo levaal chavit: "amod" – patur.

Ta shema: hakkaddarin vehazzaggagin shehayu mehallechin ze achar ze; nitkal harishon venafal, venitkal hashsheni barishon, vehashshelishi bashsheni – rishon chayyayv benizke sheni, vesheni chayyayv benizke shelishi. veim mechamat rishon naflu – rishon chayyayv benizke kullam. veim hizhiru ze et ze – peturin. may, lav shello haya lahen laamod?
Lo, shehaya lahen laamod.
Aval lo haya lahem laamod may, patur? i hachi, addetane sefa: im hizhiru ze et ze – patur; liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – shehaya lahen laamod, aval lo haya lahen laamod – peturin!
Ha ka mashma lan – deaf al gav dehaya lahen laamod, ki hizhiru ze et ze – peturin.
Amar rava: rishon chayyayv benizke sheni – ben benizke gufo, ben benizke mamono. sheni chayyayv benizke shelishi – benizke gufo, aval lo benizke mamono.
Mimma nafshach? i nitkal poshea hu – sheni name lichayyayv! i nitkal lav poshea hu – afillu rishon name lippetar!
b: Rishon – vadday poshea hu. sheni – aggufo michayyayv, dehaya lo laamod velo amad. ammamono patur, deamar leh: hay bera – lav ana keriteh.
Metivi: kullan chayyayvin al nizke gufan, ufeturin al nizke mamonan. may, lav afillu rishon?
La, levar merishon. veha "kullam" katane! amar rav adda bar ahava: "kullan" – hannizzakin.
Hay may? i amrat bishlama afillu rishon – hayeynu dekatane "kullan"; ella i amrat levar merishon, may "kullan"? litne "hannizzakin"!

Ella amar rava: rishon chayyayv – ben benizke gufo desheni, ben benizke mamono desheni; vesheni chayyayv benizke shelishi – benizke gufo, aval lo benizke mamono. may tama? dehave leh bor, velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim.
Hanicha lishmuel, deamar: kol takkala – bor hu; ella lerav, deamar: i afkereh in, i la la; may ikka lememar?
Leolam – kidamar meikkara, udekashya lach "kullan chayyayvin" – targema rav adda bar minyome kammeh deravina: shehuzzeku kelim bechelim.
Amar mar: im mechamat rishon naflu – rishon chayyayv benizke chullam. mechamat rishon hechi nafel? rav pappa amar: defaske leorcheh keshilda. rav zevid amar: kechutera desamyuta.
Mishna ze ba bechavito veze ba bekorato, nishbera kaddo shel ze bekorato shel ze – patur; shellaze reshut lehallech, velaze reshut lehallech.
Haya baal hakkora rishon uvaal chavit acharon; nishbera chavit bekora – patur baal hakkora.

a: Veim amad baal kora – chayyayv. veim amar levaal chavit "amod" – patur.
Haya baal chavit rishon uvaal kora acharon; nishbera chavit bakkora – chayyayv. veim amad baal chavit – patur. veim amar levaal kora: "amod" – chayyayv. vechen ze ba benero veze befishtano.
Gemara bea minneh rabbah bar natan merav huna: hammazzik et ishto betashmish hammitta, mahu? kevan devirshut kaaved – patur, o dilma, ibbei leh leayyone?
Amar leh, tenetuha: shellaze reshut lehallech, velaze reshut lehallech.
Amar rava: kal vachomer. uma yaar – shezze lirshuto nichnas veze lirshuto nichnas, naasa kemi shennichnas lirshut chavero – vechayyayv; ze, shellirshut chavero nichnas, lo kol shekken?
Ella ha katane shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech!
Hatam – tarvayyhu kahadade ninhu; hacha – ihu kaaved maase.
Vehi la?! vehachtiv: "venichretu hannefashot haosot mikkerev ammam"!
Hanaa – letarvayyhu it lehu, ihu maase hu dekaaved.
Haya baal kora rishon kulei. amar resh lakish: shete parot birshut harabbim, achat revutza veachat mehallechet; baata mehallechet barvutza – petura. baata revutza bammehallechet – chayyevet.
Lema mesayyay leh: haya baal kora rishon uvaal chavit acharon, nishbera hechavit bakora – patur. veim amad baal kora – chayyayv. veha hacha, dechirvutza bammehallechet dame, vekatane chayyayv.
Vetisbera?! ha sayyoye baaya; la missatyay dela mesayyeyi, ella miksha name kashya! tama devaata, ha huzzeka mimmela – patur; veha matnitin demimmela, vekatane chayyayv.
Matnitin – difsaka leorcha keshilda; hacha – kegon dirvaa bechad gisa, ibbei la lesaggoye beiddach gisa.

Ella sefa dematnitin mesayyay leh leresh lakish – dekatane: haya baal chavit rishon uvaal kora acharon, nishbera chavit bakkora – chayyayv. veim amad baal chavit – patur. veha hacha, dechimhallechet barvutza dame, vekatane patur.
Matnitin – dechi orcheh ka mesagge; hacha – amra la: nehi deit lich reshut lesaggoye alay, levaote bi let lich reshuta.
Mishna shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim, echad ratz veechad mehallech, o shehayu shenehem ratzin, vehizziku ze et ze – shenehem peturin.
Gemara matnitin dela keisi ben yehuda. detanya, isi ben yehuda omer: ratz – chayyayv, mippene shehu meshunne. umode isi beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot shehu patur, mippene sheratz birshut.

Amar rabbi yochanan: halacha keisi ben yehuda. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: echad ratz veechad mehallech, o shehayu shenehem ratzin – peturin!
Matnitin beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot.

Mimmay? middekatane: o shehayu shenehem ratzin – peturin. ha tu lema li? hasheta echad ratz veechad mehallech – patur, shenehem ratzin mibbaya? ella hachi kaamar: echad ratz veechad mehallech – patur. bamme devarim amurim – beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, aval bachol – echad ratz veechad mehallech, chayyayv. shenehem ratzin – afillu bachol peturin.
Amar mar: umode isi beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot shehu patur, mippene sheratz birshut. beerev shabbat may birshut ikka?
Kidrabbi chanina – deamar rabbi chanina:
b: "Bou venetze likrat kalla malketa". veamri la: "likrat shabbat – kalla malketa". rabbi yannay mitattef vekae, veamar: "boi challa, boi challa".
Mishna hamevakkea birshut harabbim – vehizzik birshut hayyachid; birshut hayyachid – vehizzik birshut harabbim; birshut hayyachid – vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher, chayyayv.
Gemara utzericha; dei tena: hamevakkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim – mishshum dishchichi rabbim; aval mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, dela shechichi rabbim – ema la.
Vei tena: mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid – mishshum demeikkara shello birshut aved; aval mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, devirshut aved – ema la.
Vei tena hanach tarte – ha mishshum dishchichi rabbim, veha mishshum deshello birshut; aval mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid acher – dela shechichi rabbim, umeikkara birshut – ema la; tzericha.
Tanu rabbanan: hannichnas lachanuto shel naggar shello birshut, venitteza bekaat vetafcha al panav, vamet – patur. veim nichnas birshut – chayyayv.
May chayyayv? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: chayyayv bearbaa devarim. ufatur miggalut,
Lefi sheen dome leyaar. yaar – ze lirshuto nichnas, veze lirshuto nichnas; ze – lirshut chavero nichnas.
Amar rava: kal vachomer; uma yaar – ze ledato nichnas veze ledato nichnas, naasa kemi shennichnas ledaat chavero – vegole; ze – shelledaat chavero nichnas, lo kol shekken?!
Ella amar rava: may patur miggalut? dela saggi leh begalut. vehayeynu tama derabbi yose bar chanina, mishshum dehave leh shogeg karov lemezid.

Metiv rava: hosif lo retzua achat, vamet – hare ze gole al yado. veha hacha deshogeg karov lemezid hu, deibbei assoke addateh demayyte inashe bachada retzua, vekatane: hare ze gole! amar rav shimi minnehardea: detae beminyana.
Tefach leh rava besandaleh, amar leh: attu hu mane?! vehatanya: gadol shebbedayyaynin kore, vehashsheni mone, vehashshelishi omer: "hakkehu"!
Ella amar rav shimi minnehardea: dita dayyayna gufeh.
Metivi: hazzorek et haeven lirshut harabbim, veharag – hare ze gole. veha hacha, deshogeg karov lemezid hu – deibbei leh assoke addateh devirshut harabbim shechichi inashe; vekatane: hare ze gole!
Amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: besoter et kotlo.
Ibbei leh ayyone! besoter ballayla.
Ballayla name ibbei leh ayyone! besoter et kotlo bayyom – leashpa.
Hay ashpa hechi dame? i dishchichi rabbim – mezid hu! vei la shechichi rabbim – anus hu!

Amar rav pappa: [la tzericha, ella] beashpa haasuya lehippanot ballayla, veenah asuya lehippanot bayyom, veikka demikkere veyatev; mezid la have – deha enah asuya lehippanot bayyom, anus name la have – deha ikka demikkere veyatev.

Rav pappa mishshemeh derava matni la aresha: hannichnas lachanuto shel naggar shello birshut, venitteza lo bekaat vetafcha lo al panav, vamet – patur. amar rabbi yose bar chanina: chayyayv bearbaa devarim, ufatur miggalut.
Man dematne la assefa – kol shekken aresha; uman dematne la aresha – aval assefa, kevan devirshut – chayyayv galut.
Umi chayyayv galut? vehatanya: hannichnas lachanuto shel nappach, venittezu nitzotzot vetafchu lo al panav vamet – patur, vaafillu nichnas birshut!
Hacha bemay askinan – bishvalya denappache. shevalya denappache lemiktele kae? kesherabbo mesarhev bo latzet, veeno yotze.
Umishshum derabbo mesarhev bo latzet – lemikteleh kae?! kesavur yatza. i hachi, acher name!

a: Acher – let leh emta derabbeh, hay – it leh emta derabbeh.

Rav zevid mishshemeh derava matne la aha: "umatza" – perat lemamtzi et atzmo. mikkan amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: mi sheyyatzta even mittachat yado, vehotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah – patur. amar rabbi yose bar chanina: patur miggalut, vechayyayv bearbaa devarim.
Man dematne la aha – kol shekken akkammayyta; uman dematne la akkammayyta – aval aha patur ligmare.

Tanu rabbanan: poalim shebbau litboa secharan mibbaal habbayit, unegachan shoro shel baal habbayit uneshachan kalbo shel baal habbayit, vamet – patur. acherim omrim: rashshain poalin litboa secharan mibbaal habbayit.
Hechi dame? i dishchiach bemata – may tama daacherim? i dishchiach babbayit – may tama detanna kamma?
La tzericha, begavra dishchiach vela shechiach, vekare abbava vaamar lehu "in"; mar savar: "in" – "ul ta" mashma. umar savar: "in" – "kum adduchetach" mashma.

Tanya keman deamar "in" – "kum adduchetach" mashma, detanya: poel shennichnas litboa secharo mibbaal habbayit, unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit o neshacho kalbo, patur – af al pi shennichnas birshut. ammay patur? ella lav dekare abbava, veamar leh "in", ushema minna "in" – "kum adduchetach" mashma.
Mishna shene shevorin tammin shechavlu ze et ze – meshallemin bammotar chatzi nezek. shenehen muadin – meshallemin bammotar nezek shalem.
Echad tam veechad muad – muad battam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, tam bamuad meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek.
Vechen shene anashim shechavlu ze baze – meshallemin bammotar nezek shalem.

Adam bamuad umuad baadam – meshallem bammotar nezek shalem. adam battam vetam baadam – adam battam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, tam baadam meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. rabbi akiva omer: af tam shechaval baadam – meshallem bammotar nezek shalem.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "kammishpat hazze yease lo" – kemishpat shor beshor, kach mishpat shor beadam. ma shor beshor – tam meshallem chatzi nezek, umuad nezek shalem, af shor beadam – tam meshallem chatzi nezek, umuad nezek shalem.
Rabbi akiva omer: "kammishpat hazze" – kattachton, velo kaelyon.
Yachol meshallem min haaliyyay, talmud lomar: "yease lo" – miggufo meshallem, veeno meshallem min haaliyyay.
Verabbanan – "ze" lema li? lefotro mearbaa devarim.
Verabbi akiva – lefotro mearbaa devarim mena leh? nafka leh meish ki yitten mum baamito"; "ish baamito" – velo shor baamito.
Verabbanan – i mehahi hava amena tzaar lechodeh, aval rippuy vashevet ema litten leh; ka mashma lan.
Mishna shor shave mane shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa kelum – notel et hashshor.
Gemara matnitin manni – rabbi akiva hi. detanya: yusham hashshor bevet din, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: huchelat hashshor.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi yishmael savar: baal chov hu, vezuze hu demassek leh. verabbi akiva savar: shuttafe ninhu.
Vekamippalgi behay kera: "umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo" – rabbi yishmael savar: leve dina kamazhar rachamana; verabbi akiva savar: lenizzak umazzik mazhar lehu rachamana.
May benayyhu? hikdisho nizzak ikka benayyhu.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: mecharo mazzik, lerabbi yishmael mahu? kevan deamar rabbi yishmael baal chov hu, vezuze hu demassek leh – machur; o dilma,
b: Kevan dimshabad leh lenizzak – lav kol keminneh? amar leh: eno machur.
Vehatanya: mecharo – machur! chozer vegovehu. vechi meachar shechozer vegovehu, lamma machur? leridya.
Shema minna: love umocher mittaltelin – bet din govin lo mehem? shane hatam, dichman daasao appoteke dame.
Vehaamar rava: asa avdo appoteke, umecharo – baal chov gove hemennu. shoro appoteke umecharo – en baal chov gove hemennu!
Eved may tama – mishshum deit leh kala; hay name, kevan dingach – kala it leh, detora nagchana" karu leh.
Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: mecharo – en machur, hikdisho – mukedash.
Mecharo man? ilema mazzik, "mecharo en machur" manni – rabbi akiva hi, deamar: huchelat hashshor; vehikdisho mukedash" – atan lerabbi yishmael, deamar: yusham hashshor bevet din!
Ella nizzak? "mecharo eno machur" manni – rabbi yishmael, "hikdisho mukedash" atan lerabbi akiva!
Leolam mazzik, vedivre hakkol; "mecharo eno machur" – afillu lerabbi yishmael, deha meshabeda leh lenizzak.
"Hikdisho mukedash" – afillu lerabbi akiva, mishshum derabbi avahu; deamar rabbi avahu: gezera shemma yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon.

Tanu rabbanan: shor tam shehizzik; ad shello amad baddin – mecharo machur, hikdisho mukedash, shechato unetano bemattana – ma sheasa asuy. mishsheamad baddin – mecharo eno machur, hikdisho eno mukedash, shechato unetano bemattana – lo asa velo chelum.
Kadmu baale chovot (vehigbiho) [vegavuhu]; ben chav ad shello hizzik, ben hizzik ad shello chav – lo asu velo kelum, lefi sheen mishtallem ella miggufo.

Muad shehizzik – ben sheamad baddin, ben shello amad baddin; mecharo machur, hikdisho mukedash, shechato unetano bemattana – ma sheasa asuy. kadmu baale chovot (vehigbihu) [vegavuhu]; ben chav ad shello hizzik, ben hizzik ad shello chav – ma sheasa asuy, lefi sheen mishtallem ella min haaliyyay.
Amar mar: "mecharo machur" – leridya.
"Hikdisho mukedash" – mishshum derabbi avahu.
"Shechato unetano bemattana, ma sheasa asuy"; bishlama netano bemattana, ma sheasa asuy – leridya; ella shechato – lete velishtallam mibbisreh!
Detanya: "chay" – en li ella chay, shechato minnayin? talmud lomar: "umachru et hashshor" mikkol makom.
Amar rav shezvi: lo nitzrecha ella lifchat shechita.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: zot omeret, hammazzik shibudo shel chavero – patur.
Peshita! mahu detema, hatam hu deamar leh: la chassartaych vela midde – deamar leh: zika bealma hu dishkali minnach; aval bealma lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Ha name rabba amra – deamar rabba: hassoref shetarotav shel chavero – patur!

Mahu detema, hatam hu deamar leh: neyayra bealma kelay minnach; aval hecha dechafar bah borot shichin umearot, lichayyayv; ka mashma lan – deha hacha keman dechafar bah borot shichin umearot dame, vekaamar: ma sheasa asuy.
Kadmu baale chovot (vehigbihu) [vegavuhu]; ben chav ad shello hizzik, ben hizzik ad shello chav – lo asa velo chelum, lefi sheen meshallem ella miggufo.
Bishlama hizzik ad shello chav – nizzakin kadmu. aval chav ad shello hizzik – baal chov kedem!

a: Vaafillu hizzik ad shello chav – baal chov kedem! shema minna, baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava – ma sheggava lo gava?!
La, leolam ema lach: ma sheggava gava; veshane hatam, daamar leh: illu gabbach hava – la minnach (hava) gevay leh? dehay tora deazzekan, minneh mishtallemna.

Tanu rabbanan: shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, vechaval bo bachamishshim zuz, veshavach veamad al arba meot zuz – sheilmale lo hizziko haya omed al shemone meot zuz; noten kishat hannezek.
Kachash – kishat haamada baddin.
Shavach mazzik – noten lo kishat hannezek. kachash – kishat haamada baddin.
Amar mar: shavach mazzik – noten kishat hannezek. manni – rabbi yishmael hi, deamar: baal chov hu, vezuze hu demassek leh;
Ema sefa: kachash – kishat haamada baddin. atan lerabbi akiva, deamar: shuttafe ninhu! resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva?!
La, kulla rabbi akiva hi; vehacha bemay askinan – kesheppittemo.
I kesheppittemo, ema resha: shavach veamad al arba meot zuz – noten lo kishat hannezek. i kesheppittemo, tzericha lememar?!

Amar rav pappa: resha – mashkachat la ben defattema pattome ben dishvacha mimmela, veitzterich leashmoinan dehecha dishvacha mimmela – noten lo kishat hannezek. sefa – la mashkachat la ella kesheppittemo.
Kachash – kishat haamada baddin. kachash mechamat may? ilema dechachasha mechamat melacha, lema leh: at machchashat, vaana yahevna?!
Amar rav ashe: dichchash mechamat makka, daamar leh: karna detorach kevira beh.
Mishna shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa kelum – amar rabbi meir, al ze neemar: "umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo".

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: vechen halacha; kiyyaymta "umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo", velo kiyyaymta "vegam hammet yechetzun"! veeze? ze shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz; shezze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz – ze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, vezehu shor haamur battora; divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi meir omer: en zehu shor haamur battora, ella shor shave matayim shennagach leshor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa kelum, al ze neemar: "umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo". ella ma ani mekayyem "vegam et hammet yechetzun"? pechat sheppechatattu mita – machatzin bachay.
Mikkede ben rabbi meir ben rabbi yehuda – hay mea veesrim vachamishsha shakel, vehay mea veesrim vachamishsha shakel; may benayyhu?
Amar rava: pechat nevela ikka benayyhu. rabbi meir savar: pechat nevela – denizzak have, verabbi yehuda savar: pechat nevela – demazzik have palga.
Amar leh abbaye: im ken, matzinu lerabbi yehuda
b: Tam chamur mimmuad!
Vechi tema hachi name – keditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: tam chayyayv, umuad patur; emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda – leinyan shemira, dichtivi kerae; leinyan tashlumin mi shamat leh?!
Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: yachol shor shave mane shennagach shor shave chamesh selaim, vehannevela yafa sela – ze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet?
Amarta: vechi muad lamma yotze – lehachemir alav o lehakel alav? heve omer lehachemir alav; uma muad eno meshallem ella ma shehizzik, tam hakkal lo kol shekken?
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: shevach nevela ikka benayyhu, demar savar: denizzak have, umar savar: palga.

Vehayeynu deka kashya leh lerabbi yehuda – hasheta deamrat chas rachamana illaveh demazzik, deshakel bishvacha; yachol shor shave chamesh selaim shennagach shor shave mane, vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz – ze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet?
Amarta: hechan matzinu mazzik niskar, shezze niskar? veomer: "shallem yeshallem" – bealim meshallemin, veen bealim notlin.

May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille hecha deikka peseda lenizzak; aval hecha delekka peseda lenizzak – kegon shor shave chamesh selaim shennagach shor shave chamesh selaim, vehannevela yafa sheloshim zuz – shakel name mazzik bishvacha;
Veomer: "shallem yeshallem" – bealim meshallemin, veen bealim notlin.
Amar leh rav acha bar tachlifa lerava: im ken, matzinu lerabbi yehuda tam meshallem yoter mechatzi nezek, vehattora amra: "umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo"!
It leh lerabbi yehuda: pechat sheppachata mita – machatzin bachay.
Mena leh? mivvegam et hammet yechetzun"?! veha appekeh rabbi yehuda leze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet!
Im ken, nichtov kera: "veet hammet"! may "vegam"? shema minna tarte.
Mishna yesh chayyayv al maase shoro ufatur al maase atzmo, patur al maase shoro vechayyayv al maase atzmo.
Ketzad? shoro shebbiyyesh – patur, vehu shebbiyyesh – chayyayv. shoro shessimme et en avdo vehippil et shinno – patur, vehu shessimme et en avdo vehippil et shinno – chayyayv.

Shoro shechaval beaviv uveimmo – chayyayv, vehu shechaval beaviv veimmo – patur. shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat – chayyayv, vehu shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat – patur, mippene shehu mitchayyev benafsho.

Gemara tane rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol hamekalkelin peturin, chutz mechovel umavir. amar leh: pok tane levara! chovel umavir enah mishna. veim timtze lomar mishna; chovel – betzarich lechalbo, mavir – betzarich leefro.
Tenan: shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat – chayyayv, vehu shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat – patur. vekatane hu dumeya deshoro – ma shoro dela kavae leh,

a: Af hu name dela kavae leh; vekatane: patur – mippene shehu niddon benafsho!
Lo; shoro dumeya dideh – ma hu dekavae leh, af shoro dekavae leh.
Shoro hechi mashkachat la? amar leh rav avya: hacha bemay askinan – beshor pikkeach shealta lo neshicha begabbo, veka bae lemikleyeh veiggandar bekivtma.
Umena yadinan? dilvatar dekalyeh kamiggandar bekivtma.
Umi ikka ki hay gavvna? in; dehahu tora dahava be rav pappa dahava kayvin leh chincheh, ayel ufatkeh lenazyayta, veshate shichra veittassi.

Amaru rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: mi matzet amrat shoro dumeya dideh?! veha katane: shoro shebbiyyesh – patur, vehu shebbiyyesh – chayyayv. shoro dumeya dideh nitkavvevn levayyesh – hechi mashkachat la?
Kegon shennitkavvevn lehazzik. deamar mar: nitkavvevn lehazzik – af al pi shello nitkavvevn levayyesh.
Rava amar: matnitin beshogeg,
Vechidtana deve chizkiyya – detana deve chizkiyya: makke adam umakke behema;

Ma makke behema – lo chillakta bah ben shogeg ben mezid, ben mitkavvevn lesheen mitkavvevn, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay, lefotro mamon ella lechayyeyvo mamon; af makke adam – lo tachlok bo ben shogeg lemezid, ben mitkavvevn lesheen mitkavvevn, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay, lechayyeyvo mamon ella lefotro mamon.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: mi matzet mokmat la beshogeg? veha "mippene shenniddon benafsho" katane!
Hachi kaamar: kevan divmezid niddon benafsho, vehechi dame – deka bae leefro; hasheta beshogeg – patur.
Mishna shor shehaya rodef achar shor acher, vehuzzak; ze omer: "shorcha hizzik", veze omer: "lo chi, ella besela laka" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Hayu shenayim rodfim achar echad, ze omer: "shorcha hizzik", veze omer: "shorcha hizzik" –
b: Shenehem peturim. im hayu shenehem shel ish echad – shenehem chayyayvim.

Haya echad gadol veechad katan, hannizzak omer: "gadol hizzik", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella katan hizzik"; echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer: "muad hizzik", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella tam hizzik" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.

Hayu hannizzakin shenayim – echad gadol veechad katan, vehammazzikin shenayim – echad gadol veechad katan; hannizzak omer: "gadol hizzik et haggadol, vekatan et hakkatan", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella katan et haggadol, vegadol et hakkatan"; echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer: "muad hizzik et haggadol, vetam et hakkatan", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella tam et haggadol, umuad et hakkatan" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: [zot omeret] chalukim alav chaverav al somchos, deamar: mamon hammuttal besafek – cholkin.
Amar leh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi chiyyay bar abba: amar somchos afillu bari uvari? amar leh: in, amar somchos afillu bari uvari.
Umimmay dematnitin bevari uvari hu? dekatane: ze omer shorcha hizzik, veze omer lo chi.
Matkef la rav pappa: midderesha bari uvari – sefa name bari uvari;

Ema sefa: haya echad gadol veechad katan, nizzak omer: "gadol hizzik", umazzik omer: "lo chi, ella katan hizzik"; echad tam veechad muad, nizzak omer: "muad hizzik", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella tam hizzik" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya;
Ha la mayyte reaya – shakel kidamar mazzik; nema tihve teyuveta derabba bar natan – deamar: teano chittim vehoda lo bisorim – patur?
Ella bevari veshemma.
Dekaamar bari man, dekaamar shemma man? i nema dekaamar nizzak bari vekaamar mazzik shemma, akkatti lema tihve teyuveta derabba bar natan!
Ella dekaamar nizzak shemma, vekaamar mazzik bari.
Umiddesefa nizzak shemma umazzik bari, resha name nizzak shemma umazzik bari;
Veamar somchos afillu beha – deitzterich leashmoinan dela?!
La; sefa nizzak shemma umazzik bari, resha nizzak bari umazzik shemma.
Veha la damya resha lesefa!
Amri: bari veshemma, shemma uvari – chad milleta hi; bari uvari, shemma uvari – tere mille ninhu.
Gufa – amar rabba bar natan: teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin – patur. may ka mashma lan? tenena: teano chittin vehoda lo bisorin – patur!
I mehatam, hava amena: patur middeme chittin, vechayyayv bidme seorin. ka mashma lan defatur ligmare.
Tenan: hayu hannizzakin shenayim – echad gadol veechad katan vechulei. ha la mayyte reaya – shakel kidkaamar mazzik; ammay? chittim useorim ninhu!
Rauy littol – veen lo.
Vehatanya: hare ze mishtallem al hakkatan min haggadol, velaggadol min hakkatan!
Ditfas.

Tenan: haya echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer: "muad hizzik et haggadol, vetam et hakkatan", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella tam et haggadol, umuad et hakkatan" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. ha la mayyte reaya – shakel kidkaamar mazzik; veammay? chittin useorin ninhu!

a: Rauy littol, veen lo. vehatanya: hare ze mishtallem lakkatan min hammuad, velaggadol min hattam! ditfas.
Hayu shenehem shel ish echad – shenehem chayyayvim. amar leh rava mipparzika lerav ashe: shema minna, shevavrim tammim shehizziku – ratza mizze gove, ratza mizze gove.
Hacha bemay askinan – bemuadin.

I bemuadin, ema sefa: haya echad gadol veechad katan, hannizzak omer: "gadol hizzik", vehammazzik omer: "lo chi, ella katan hizzik" – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. i bemuadin, may nafka leh minneh? sof sof, deme tora mealleya bae leshallome!
Amar leh: sefa betammin, veresha bemuadin.
Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe: i bemuadin, "chayyayvim"?! "chayyayv gavra" mibbee leh! vetu, may "shenehem"?

Ella leolam betammin; verabbi akiva hi, deamar: shuttafin ninhu; vetama deitanhu letarvayyhu – dela matze medache leh, aval letanhu letarvayyhu – matze amar leh: zil ayyti reaya dehay tora azzekach, vaashallem lach.
Hadaran alach hammanniach

Mishna shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha shevavrim ze achar ze – yeshallem laacharon shebbahem, veim yesh bo motar – yachazir leshellefanav, veim yesh bo motar – yachazir leshellifne fanav, vehaacharon acharon niskar; divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi shimon omer: shor shave matayim shennagach leshor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa kelum – ze notel mane, veze notel mane.
Chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim – haacharon notel mane; veshellefanav – ze notel chamishshim zuz, veze notel chamishshim zuz.
Chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim – haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav chamishshim zuz, ushenayim harishonim – dinar zahav.
Gemara matnitin manni? dela kerabbi yishmael, udela kerabbi akiva!
I kerabbi yishmael deamar baale chovot ninhu, hay "acharon acharon niskar"?! "rishon rishon niskar" mibbee leh! i kerabbi akiva deamar tora deshuttafe hu, hay "yesh bo motar –
b: Yachazir leshellefanav"?! "lechullam" mibbee leh!

Amar rava: leolam kerabbi yishmael – deamar baale chovot ninhu; udekashya lach: "acharon acharon niskar"?! "rishon rishon niskar" mibbee leh! hacha bemay askinan – kegon shettefaso nizzak ligbot hemennu, venaasa alav keshomer sachar linzakin.
I hachi, "yesh bo motar – yachazir leshellefanav"?! "yachazir labbealim" mibbee leh!
Amar ravina, hachi katane: im yesh bo motar binzakav – yachazir leshellefanav.
Vechen ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum peshiat shomrin nagu bah.
Bemay okemta – kerabbi yishmael; i hachi, ema sefa, rabbi shimon omer: shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa kelum – ze notel mane veze notel mane.

Chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim – haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav – ze notel chamishshim zuz, veze notel chamishshim zuz. chazar venagach shor shave matayim – haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav notel chamishshim zuz, ushenayim harishonim dinar zahav.
Atan lerabbi akiva, deamar: tora deshuttafe hu; resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva?
Amri: in, deha amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, shevok matnitin veta batray – resha rabbi yishmael vesefa rabbi akiva.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi yochanan: hikdisho nizzak ikka benayyhu.
Tenan hatam: hattokea lachavero – noten lo sela. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: mane.
Hahu gavra ditka lechavreh. shallecheh rav toviyya bar matna lekammeh derav yosef: sela tzori tenan, o sela medina tenan?
Amar leh, tenetuha: ushenayim harishonim dinar zahav. vei salka datach tane tanna sela medina, niflog venitne ad teresar vesela!
Amar leh: tanna ki rochla litne velezil?!
May have ala? pashtuha meha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol kesef haamur battora – kesef tzori, veshel divrehem – kesef medina.
Amar leh hahu gavra: hoil ufalga dezuza hu – la baena, nitteveh laaniyyim. hadar amar leh: nitteveh nihali, ezil veavre beh nafshay.
Amar leh rav yosef: kevar zecho beh aniyyim. veaf al gav delekka aniyyim hacha, anan yad aniyyim anan. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yetomim

a: Enan tzerichin perozbul.
Vechen tane rame bar chama: hayyetomim enan tzerichin perozbul – rabban gamliel uvet dino avihen shel yetomin hayu.

Chanan bisha teka leh lehahu gavra. ata lekammeh derav huna, amar leh: zil hav leh palga dezuza. hava leh zuza macha, bae lemitteve leh minneh palga dezuza, la hava mishtekil leh. teka leh acharina, veyahaveh nihaleh.

Mishna shor shehu muad lemino, veeno muad lesheeno mino; muad leadam veeno muad livhema; muad liktannim veeno muad ligdolim; et shehu muad lo – meshallem nezek shalem, veet sheeno muad lo – meshallem chatzi nezek.
Amru lifne rabbi yehuda: hare ze muad lashshabbatot veeno muad lachol? amar lahem: lashshabbatot – meshallem nezek shalem, limot hachol – meshallem chatzi nezek.
Ematay hu tam? mishsheyyachzor bo shelosha yeme shabbatot.
Gemara ittemar, rav zevid amar: "veeno muad" tenan. rav pappa amar: "eno muad" tenan.
Rav zevid amar "veeno muad" tenan – ha setama have muad. rav pappa amar "eno muad" tenan – distama la have muad.
Rav zevid dayek missefa, rav pappa dayek meresha.

Rav zevid dayek missefa – dekatane: muad liktannim veeno muad ligdolim. i amrat bishlama "veeno muad" katane – ha setameh have muad; ha ka mashma lan – daafillu mikketannim ligdolim name, missetama have muad.
Ella i amrat "eno muad" katane – setama la have muad,
Hasheta yesh lomar mikketannim liktannim dealma, setama la have muad; mikketannim ligdolim tzericha lememar dela have muad?
Verav pappa amar lach: itzterich, salka dataych amena: hoil uferatz beh behahu mina – peratz beh, la shena gedolim dideh vela shena ketannim dideh; ka mashma lan dela have muad.
Rav pappa dayek meresha, dekatane: muad leadam eno muad livhema. i amrat bishlama "eno muad" tenan – setama la have muad; ha ka mashma lan – daafillu meadam livhema name, setama la have muad.
Ella i amrat "veeno muad" katane – ha setama have muad; hasheta yesh lomar: mibbehema livhema setama have muad, meadam livhema tzericha lememar dehave muad?!

Verav zevid amar lach: resha achazara kae – kegon dahava muad leadam umuad livhema, vahadar beh mibbehema – dekae gabbe vehema telata zimne vela nagach. mahu detema, kevan dela hadar beh meadam – chazara divhema lav chazara hi; ka mashma lan, dachazara divhema miha chazara hi.
Metivi, somchos omer: muad laadam muad livhema, mikkal vechomer – uma leadam muad, livhema lo kol shekken? mikkelal detanna kamma "eno muad" kaamar!

Amar lecha rav zevid: somchos – achazara kae, vehachi kaamar leh letanna kamma: dekaamrat chazara divhema chazara hi – chazara divhema lav chazara hi, mikkal vachomer meadam: uma meadam la ka (40)hadar beh, mibbehema lo kol shekken?
Amar rav ashe: ta shema, amru lifne rabbi yehuda: hare ze muad leshabbatot veeno muad limot hachol? amar lahen: leshabbatot – meshallem nezek shalem, limot hachol – meshallem chatzi nezek.
I amrat bishlama "veeno muad" katane – shayyole hu deka meshayyeyli [leh], vehu name kamahdar lehu. ella i amrat "eno muad" katane – agmore hu deka magmeri leh?! vetu, ihu may ka mahdar lehu?
Amar rav yannay: meresha name dayka, dekatane: et shemmuad lo – meshallem nezek shalem, veet sheeno muad lo – [meshallem] chatzi nezek.
I amrat bishlama "veeno muad" katane – paroshe ka mefaresh la.

Ella i amrat "eno muad" katane, paska; may tu "et shemmuad lo – meshallem nezek shalem, veet sheeno muad lo – meshallem chatzi nezek"? ad hasheta – la ashmeinan dehatam meshallem chatzi nezek, umuad meshallem nezek shalem?
Vei timtze lomar name ita lidrav pappa; nagach shor chamor vegamal – naasa muad lakkol.
Tanu rabbanan: raa shor – nagach, shor – lo nagach, shor – nagach, shor – lo nagach, shor – nagach, shor – lo nagach; naasa muad leserugin lishvorim.
Tanu rabbanan: raa shor – nagach, chamor – lo nagach, sus – nagach, gamal – lo nagach, pered – nagach, arod – lo nagach; naasa muad leserugin lakkol.
Ibbaya lehu: nagach
b: Shor, shor vashor, chamor vegamal, mahu?

Hay shor batra – batar shevorim shadenan leh, veakkatti lishvorim hu deiyyayad – lemidde acharina la iyyayad; o dilma, hay shor batra – batar chamor vegamal shadenan leh, veiyyayad leh lechullehu mine?

Chamor vegamal, shor, shor vashor, mahu? hay shor kamma – batar chamor vegamal shadenan leh, veiyyayad leh lechullehu mine; o dilma batar shevorim shadenan leh, veakkatti lishvorim hu deiyyayad – lemina acharina la iyyayad?

Shabbat, shabbat veshabbat, echad beshabbat vesheni beshabbat, mahu? ha shabbat batrayyta – batar shabbat hu deshadenan leh, veakkatti leshabbat hu deiyyayad – limot hachol la iyyayad; o dilma batar echad beshabbat vesheni beshabbat shadenan leh, veiyyayad leh lechulle yoma?

Chamishi beshabbat veerev shabbat veshabbat, shabbat veshabbat, mahu? ha shabbat kammayyta – batar chamishi beshabbat veerev shabbat shadenan leh, veiyyayad lechullehu yome; o dilma ha shabbat kammayyta – batar shabbatot hu deshadenan leh, uleshebbatot hu deiyyayad?
Teku.
Nagach shor yom chamishsha asar bechodesh ze, veyom shishsha asar bechodesh ze, veyom shiva asar bechodesh ze – pelugeta derav ushemuel,
Deittemar: raata yom chamishsha asar bechodesh ze, veyom shishsha asar bechodesh ze, veyom shiva asar bechodesh ze – rav amar: kava lah veset, ushemuel amar: ad shetteshallesh bedillug.
Amar rava: shama kol shofar venagach, kol shofar venagach, kol shofar venagach – naasa muad leshofarot.
Peshita! mahu detema: hach shofar kamma – seyuta bealma hu denakteh; ka mashma lan.
Mishna shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel hekdesh, veshel hekdesh shennagach leshor shel hedyot – patur, shenneemar: "shor reehu" – velo shor shel hekdesh.
Shor shel yisrael shennagach leshor shel goy – patur. veshel goy shennagach leshor shel yisrael – ben tam ben muad, meshallem nezek shalem.

Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi shimon ben menasya, detanya: shor shel hedyot shennagach shor shel hekdesh, veshel hekdesh shennagach shor shel hedyot – patur, shenneemar: "shor reehu" – velo shor shel hekdesh. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: shor shel hekdesh shennagach shor shel hedyot – patur; veshel hedyot shennagach shor shel hekdesh – ben tam ben muad, meshallem nezek shalem.
Amri: may ka savar rabbi shimon? i "reehu" davka – afillu shel hedyot shennagach shel hekdesh lippetar! vei "reehu" lav davka – afillu dehekdesh name, ki nagach dehedyot lichayyayv!

Vechi tema: leolam kasavar "reehu" davka, umihu dehedyot ki nagach dehekdesh hayeynu tama demichayyayv – mishshum deka mayyte leh mikkal vachomer dehedyot: uma hedyot shennagach shel hedyot – chayyayv, ki nagach dehekdesh – lo kol shekken demichayyayv?
Dayyo labba min haddin – lihyot kanniddon! ma lehallan – tam chatzi nezek, hacha name chatzi nezek!

Ella amar resh lakish: hakkol hayu bichlal nezek shalem; keshepparat lecha hakkatuv: "reehu" gabbe tam – reehu hu detam meshallem chatzi nezek; mikkelal dehekdesh – ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem;

a: Deim ken, nichtov kera lehay "reehu" gabbe muad.

Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy – patur. amri: mimma nafshach, i "reehu" davka – degoy ki nagach deyisrael name lippetar! vei "reehu" lav davka – afillu deyisrael ki nagach degoy nichayyayv!
Amar rabbi avahu, amar kera: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vayyatter goyim" – raa sheva mitzvot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach. kevan shello kiyyeymu – amad vehittir mamonan leyisrael.
Rabbi yochanan amar mehacha: "hofia mehar paran" – mipparan hofia mamonam leyisrael.

Tanya name hachi: shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy – patur. shor shel goy shennagach shor shel yisrael – ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem, shenneemar: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vayyatter goyim". veomer: "hofia mehar paran".
May "veomer"?

Vechi tema, hay "amad vaymoded eretz" – mibbaya leh lechidrav matna vechidrav yosef, ta shema: "hofia mehar paran" – mipparan hofia mamonan leyisrael. may derav matna? deamar rav matna: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vechulei". ma raa – raa sheva mitzvot shennitztauu alehen bene noach velo kiyyeymum, amad vehigla otam meal admatam.
Umay mashma dehay "vayyatter" lishshana deiggalloye hu? ketiv hacha: "vayyatter goyim", uchetiv hatam: "lenatter bahen al haaretz" – umetargeminan: lekappatza behon al ara.
May derav yosef? deamar rav yosef: "amad vaymoded eretz, raa vechulei"; ma raa? raa sheva mitzvot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach velo kiyyeymum, amad vehittiran lahem.
Ittegore ittegur?! im ken, matzinu chote niskar! amar mar bereh deravna: lomar sheafillu mekayyeymin otan – en mekabbelin alehen sachar.

Vela?! vehatanya, rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu goy veosek battora – shehu kechohen gadol? talmud lomar: "asher yaase otam haadam, vachay bahem" – "kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim" lo neemar, ella "adam"; ha lamadta, sheafillu goy veosek battora – hare hu kechohen gadol!
Amri: en mekabbelim alehen sachar kimtzuvvev veose, ella kemi sheeno metzuvvev veose. deamar rabbi chanina: gadol hametzuvvev veose yoter mimmi sheeno metzuvvev veose.

Tanu rabbanan, uchevar shalcha malchut romi shene seradyotot etzel chachme yisrael: lammedunu toratchem. karu veshanu veshilleshu. bishat petiratan amru lahem: dikdaknu bechol toratchem – veemet hu; chutz middavar ze sheattem omrim: shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy – patur. shel goy shennagach shor shel yisrael – ben tam ben muad, meshallem nezek shalem.
Mimma nafshach, i "reehu" davka – afillu degoy ki nagach deyisrael lippetar; vei "reehu" lav davka – afillu deyisrael ki nagach degoy lichayyayv! vedavar ze en anu modiim oto lammalchut.

Rav shemuel bar yehuda shechiva leh beratta, amaru leh rabbanan leulla: kum nezil ninachameh, amar lehu: may it li gabbe nechamta devavlae – degiddufa hu? deamri: "may efshar lemibad"; ha efshar lemibad – avdi.

Azal hu lechodeh gabbeh. amar leh: "vayyomer Adonai (el moshe) al tatzar et moav veal titgar bam milchama"; vechi ma ala al dato shel moshe, laasot milchama shello birshut?! ella nasa moshe kal vachomer beatzmo – amar: uma midyanim shello bau ella laazor et moav, amra tora: "tzaror et hammidyanim vehikkitem otam",
b: Moavim atzman lo kol shekken?
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: lo keshealta al datecha alta al dati, shete peridot tovot yesh li lehotzi mehen – rut hammoaviyya venaama haammonit.

Vahalo devarim kal vachomer, uma bishvil shete peridot tovot – chas hakkadosh baruch hu al shete ummot gedolot velo hecherivan; bitto shel rabbi – im keshera hi ureuya hi latzet mimmenna davar tov, al achat kamma vechamma dahava chayya.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: en hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach sechar kol beriyya, afillu sechar sicha naa.
Deillu bechira dekaamra "moav", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe "al tatzar et moav veal titgar vam milchama" – milchama hu dela, ha angarya aved behu;
Tzeira dekaamra "ben ammi", amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: "vekaravta mul bene ammon, al tetzurem veal titgar bam" – kelal, daafillu angarya la taaved behu.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva, shebbishvil layla achat shekkedamatta bechira litzira – kedamatta arba dorot leyisrael: oved, yishay, vedavid, ushelomo; veillu tzeira – ad rechavam, dichtiv: "veshem immo naama haammonit".
