Tanu rabbanan: shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel kuti – patur; veshel kuti shennagach shor shel yisrael – tam meshallem chatzi nezek, umuad meshallem nezek shalem.
Rabbi meir omer: shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel kuti – patur. veshel kuti shennagach shor shel yisrael – ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem.
Lememra desavar rabbi meir: kutim gere arayot hen?
Vrminhi: kol hakketamim habbaim merkam – tehorim. rabbi yehuda metamme, mippene shehen gerim vetoim.
Mibben haggoyim – tehorim. mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim – rabbi meir metamme; vachachamim metaharin – shello nechshedu yisrael al kitmehen.
Alma kasavar rabbi meir kutim gere emet hem!
Amar rabbi avahu: kenas hu shekkanas rabbi meir bemamonam, shello yittamu bahem.
Metiv rabbi zera: veellu nearot sheyyesh lahem kenas – habba al hammamzeret, veal hannetina, veal hakkutit. vei salka datach kanas rabbi meir bemamonam, hachi name niknos, kede shello yittamu bahen!
Amar abbaye: kede

a: Shello yehe chote niskar.
Venitteveh laaniyyim! amar rav mari: mishshum dehave mamon sheen lo tovim.
Mishna shor shel pikkeach shennagach shor shel cheresh shote vekatan – chayyayv. veshel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach shor shel pikkeach – patur.
Shor shel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach – bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos, umeidin lahen bifne appotroppos.
Nitpakkeach hacheresh, nishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan – chazar letammuto, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: hare hu bechezkato.
Shor haitztadin – eno chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "ki yiggach" – velo sheyyaggichuhu.

Gemara ha gufa kashya – amrat: shor shel cheresh shote vekatan, shennagach shor shel pikkeach – patur; alma en maamidin appotroppos letam – ligbot miggufo. ema sefa: shor shel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach – bet din maamidin lahem appotroppos, umeidin lahem bifne appotroppos. alma maamidin lahem appotroppos letam, ligbot miggufo!
Amar rava, hachi katane: veim huchezku nagchanin – maamidin lahem appotroppos, umeidin lahen bifne appotroppos, umeshavvenan lehu muad; dechi hadar venagach – leshallem mealiyyay.
Mealiyyayt man? rabbi yochanan amar: mealiyyayt yetomin, rabbi yose bar chanina amar: mealiyyayt appotroppos.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav assi: en nizkakin lenichse yetomin, ella im ken ribbit ochelet bahen.
Verabbi yochanan amar: o lishtar sheyyesh bo ribbit, o lichtubbat ishsha mishshum mezone!
Efoch – rabbi yochanan amar: mealiyyayt appotroppesin, rabbi yose bar chanina amar: mealiyyayt yetomin.
Amar rava: mishshum dekashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan – meshavvet leh lerabbi yose bar chanina toe? veha rabbi yose bar chanina dayyayna hu, venachet leumekeh dedina!
Ella leolam la tefoch, umazzik shane. rabbi yochanan amar mealiyyayt yetomim – dei amrat mealiyyayt appotroppos,
b: Mimmani vela avdi. rabbi yose bar chanina amar mealiyyayt appotroppos – vechozrin venifrain min hayyetomim lechi gadli.
Umaamidim lahen appotroppin letam ligbot miggufo" – tannae hi,

Detanya: shor shennitcharshu bealav, veshennishtattu bealav, veshehalchu bealav limdinat hayyam – yehuda ben nekosa amar somchos: hare hu betammuto ad sheyyaidu bo bifne habbealim. vachachamim omrim: maamidin lahen appotroppin, umeidin bahen bifne appotroppin.

Nitpakkeach hacheresh, nishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan – uvau bealav mimmedinat hayyam, yehuda ben nekosa amar somchos: chazar letammuto, ad sheyyaidu bo bifne vealim. rabbi yose amar: hare hu bechezkato.
Amaru: may "hare hu betammuto" dekaamar somchos? illema dela miyyayad kelal – ha middekatane sefa "chazar letammuto", mikkelal deiyyayad!

Ella may "hare hu betammuto" – hare hu bitmimuto, dela mechasserinan leh. alma en maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo. vachachamim omrim: maamidin lahen appotroppos, umeidin lahen bifne appotroppos – alma maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo.
Vesefa bemay kamippalgi? reshut meshanna ikka benayyhu – somchos savar: reshut meshanna, verabbi yose savar: reshut enah meshanna.
Tanu rabbanan: shor cheresh shote vekatan shennagach – rabbi yaakov meshallem chatzi nezek.
Rabbi yaakov may avidteh? ella ema, rabbi yaakov omer: meshallem chatzi nezek.

Bemay askinan? i betam – peshita, dechulle alma name chatzi nezek hu dimshallem! vei bemuad, i deavdi leh shemira – kelal kelal la bae leshallome, vei dela avdi leh shemira – kulleh nezek bae shallome!
Amar rava: leolam bemuad, vehacha bemay askinan – deavdi shemira pechuta, vela avdi leh shemira meulla.
Verabbi yaakov savar la kerabbi yehuda – deamar: tzad tammut bimkomah omedet; vesavar la kerabbi yehuda – deamar: muad saggi leh bishmira pechuta;
Vesavar la kerabbanan – deamri: maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo.

Amar leh abbaye: vela peligi?! vehatanya: shor shel cheresh, shote vekatan shennagach – rabbi yehuda mechayyev, verabbi yaakov omer: chatzi nezek hu dimshallem! amar rabba bar ulla: ma shemmechayyev rabbi yehuda peresh rabbi yaakov.
Uleabbaye deamar peligi, bemay peligi?
Amar lach: hacha bemay askinan – bemuad, vela natreh kelal.

Rabbi yaakov savar la kerabbi yehuda bachada, ufelig aleh bachada. savar kerabbi yehuda bachada – deillu rabbi yehuda savar: tzad tammut bimkomah omedet; ufelig aleh bachada – deillu rabbi yehuda savar: maamidin lahen appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo, verabbi yaakov savar: en maamidin, vela meshallem ella palga demuad.
Amar leh rav acha bar abbaye leravina: bishlama leabbaye deamar peligi – shappir; ella lerava deamar la peligi – addemoke la bemuad, nokma betam!

a: I lerabbi yehuda – daavad leh shemira pechuta, vela avad leh shemira meulla. i lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov – dela aved leh shemira kelal;
Detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: echad tam veechad muad sheshshemaran shemira pechuta – peturin. veha ka mashma lan rabbi yaakov – demaamidin (lahen) appotroppin letam, ligbot miggufo.
Amar leh: hachi kaamar – chada deit beh tarte tama.

Ravina amar: reshut meshanna ikka benayyhu – kegon dahava muad; venitpakkeach hacheresh, venishtappa hashshote, vehigdil hakkatan. rabbi yehuda savar: hare hu bechezkato, rabbi yaakov savar: reshut meshanna.
Tanu rabbanan: appotroppesim meshallemin min haaliyyay, veen meshallemin kofer.
Man tena kufera – kappara, veyatme lav bene chappara ninhu?
Amar rav chisda: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, detanya: "venatan pidyon nafsho" – deme nizzak. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: deme mazzik.
May, lav beha kamippalgi – derabbanan savri: kufera mamona hu; verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka savar: kufera kappara?
Amar rav pappa: la; dechulle alma kufera kappara hu, vehacha beha kamippalgi – rabbanan savri: bidnizzak shayyminan, verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka savar: bidmazzik shayyminan.
May tama derabbanan? neemra "shita" lematta, veneemra "shita" lemala; ma lehallan bidnizzak, af kan bidnizzak.
Verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka savar: "venatan pidyon nafsho" ketiv.
Verabbanan: in, "pidyon nafsho" ketiv; mihu ki shayyminan – bidnizzak shayyminan.
Meshabbach leh rava lerav nachman bidrav acha bar yaakov, deadam gadol hu. amar leh: lichsheyyavo leyadcha, haviehu leyadi.
Ki ata legabbeh, amar leh: bae minnay milleta. bea minneh: shor shel shene shuttafin, ketzad meshallemin kofer?
Meshallem hay kofer vehay kofer? kofer echad amar rachamana, velo shene chuferin! hay chatzi chofer vehay chatzi chofer? kofer shalem amar rachamana, velo chatzi chofer!
Addeyatev veka meayyen ba, amar leh – tenan: chayyayve arachin – memashkenin otan. chayyayve chattaot vaashamot – en memashkenin otan. chayyayve chuferin may?
Kevan dechappara hu – kechattat veasham dame, michmar chamir illaveh vela bae mashkoneh; o dilma, kevan dilchavreh hu devae mitteva leh – mamona hu vela legavoah hu, vela chamir aleh, uvae mashkoneh?
I name, kevan dehu la chata, umamoneh hu deazzek – la chamir milleta illaveh, uvae mashkoneh.
Amar leh: shivkan, estaggar bekammayyta.
Tanu rabbanan: shealo bechezkat tam, venimtza muad – bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek, veshoel meshallem chatzi nezek.
Huad bevet shoel, vehechziro labbealim – bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek, veshoel patur mikkelum.
Amar mar: shealo bechezkat tam, venimtza muad – bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek, veshoel chatzi nezek. veammay? lema leh: tora sheeli, arya la sheeli!
Amar rav: hacha bemay askinan – shehikkir bo shehu nagchan.
Venema leh: tam sheeli, muad la sheeli!
Mishshum deamar leh: sof sof i tam hava – palga nizka baet shallome; hasheta name, zil shallem palga nizka.
Venema leh: i tam – hava mishtallem miggufo!
Mishshum deamar leh: sof sof, at – lav tora baet shallome ledidi?
Venema leh:
b: Im tam – hava modena, umippetaryna!
Vaafillu leman deamar palga nizka mamona, nema leh: i tam hu – hava maarekna leh leagma!
Ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon deakdem be dina, vetafseh.
I hachi, bealim ammay meshallemim chatzi nezek? nema leh: atpasteh letoray – bida [d]man dela matzena leishtaoye dina bahadeh! mishshum deamar leh: i ahdarteh nihalach, lav minnach havo shakli leh?!
Venema leh: i ahdarteh nihali, hava maarekna leh leagma! mishshum deamar leh: sof sof, lav mealiyyay havo mishtallemi?!
Hanicha hecha deit leh nichse, hecha delet leh nichse may ikka lememar?
Mishshum deamar leh: ki hecha demishtabadna ledidach, hachi name mishtabadna lehaych – midderabbi natan.
Detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, vachavero bachavero – minnayin shemmotziin mizze, venotnim laze? talmud lomar: "venatan laasher asham lo".
Huad bevet shoel, vehechziro labbealim – bealim meshallemin chatzi nezek, veshoel patur mikkelum.
Sefa – reshut meshanna, resha – reshut enah meshanna!
Amar rabbi yochanan: tivra; mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.
Rabba amar: midderesha reshut enah meshanna, sefa name reshut enah meshanna. vesefa hayeynu tama – mishshum deamar leh: lav kol keminach dimyayadat leh letoray.
Rav pappa amar: middesefa reshut meshanna, resha name reshut meshanna; veresha hayeynu tama – mishshum dechol makom sheholech, shem bealav alav.
Shor haitztadin eno chayyayv mita. ibbaya lehu: mahu legabbe mizbeach?
Rav amar: kasher, ushemuel amar: pasul. rav amar kasher – anus hu. ushemuel amar pasul – hare neevda[5] bo avera.
Metivi: "min habbehema" – lehotzi et harovea veet hannirba. "min habbakar" – lehotzi et hanneevad. "min hatztzon" – lehotzi et hammuketze. "umin hatztzon" – lehotzi et hannogeach.
Amar rabbi shimon: im neemar rovea – lamma neemar nogeach? veim neemar nogeach – lamma neemar rovea?
Mippene sheyyesh barovea sheen bannogeach, veyesh bannogeach sheen barovea.
Rovea – asa bo ones keratzon, nogeach – lo asa bo ones keratzon. nogeach – meshallem kofer, rovea – eno meshallem et hakkofer. lefichach hutzerach lomar rovea, vehutzerach lomar nogeach.
Katane mihat, rovea – asa bo ones keratzon, nogeach – lo asa bo ones keratzon. lemay hilcheta? lav lekorban?
La, liktala.
Hachi name mistabbera; dei amrat lekorban, "nogeach lo asa bo ones keratzon"?! lav ones dideh ketiv, velav ratzon dideh ketiv! ella lav liktala?
Amar mar: nogeach – meshallem et hakkofer, rovea – eno meshallem et hakkofer. hechi dame? illema derava vekatla – ma li katla bekarna, ma li katla birvia?
Veella derava vela katla? hay dela meshallem kofer – mishshum dela katla hu!
Amar abbaye: leolam derava vela katla, deatyuha leve dina vekatluha; mahu detema

a: Keman dekatla dame, ka mashma lan.
Rava amar: leolam derava vekatla; udeka kashya lach: ma li katla bekarnayim, ma li katla birvia – keren kauonato lehazzik, hay kauonato lahanaat atzmo hu.
Bemay peligi? beregel sheddarsa al gabbe tinok bachatzar hannizzak; leabbaye – meshallem kofer, lerava – la meshallem kofer.
Tanya kevoteh derav: shor haitztadin – eno chayyayv mita, vechasher legabbe mizbeach; mippene shehu kimusse.

Mishna shor shennagach et haadam, umet – muad meshallem kofer, vetam patur min hakkofer. veze veze chayyayvin mita. vechen babben, vechen babbat. nagach eved o ama – noten sheloshim selaim; ben shehu yafe mea mane, uven sheeno yafe ella dinar echad.
Gemara vechi meachar demittam katlinan leh, muad hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rabba: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheamaduhu lishlosha bene adam.
Rav ashe amar: umedana lav kelum hu. ella hacha bemay askinan – kegon shessikken lishlosha bene adam.
Rav zevid amar: kegon sheharag shalosho behemot.
Umuad livhema have muad leadam? ella amar rav shimi: kegon sheharag shelosha goyim.
Umuad legoyim have muad leyisrael? ella amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kegon sheharag shelosha bene adam terefa.
Umuad litrefa have muad leshalem? ella amar rav pappa: diktal vaarak leagma, diktal vaarak leagma.
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar: kegon shehuzemu zomme zommin.
Hanicha i leyayode tora baenan – shappir. ella i leyayode gavra baenan, memar amar leh: la hava yadana! kegon deamri: kol emat dekatel toreh, gabbeh hava kae.
Ravina amar: bemakkirin et baal hashshor, veen makkirin et hashshor.
May hava leh lemebad? mishshum deamri leh: tora nagchana it lach bevakrach, ibbei lach nattore kulle bakrach.

Veze vaze chayyayvin mita kulei. tanu rabbanan: mimmashma shenneemar "sakol yissakel hashshor" – eni yodea shennevela hi, unevela asura baachila? ma talmud lomar "lo yeachel et besaro"? maggid lecha hakkatuv, sheim shechato leachar shennigmar dino – asur baachila.
En li ella baachila, bahanaa minnayin? talmud lomar: "uvaal hashshor naki".
May mashma? shimon ben zoma omer, keadam sheomer lachavero: "yatza ish peloni naki minnechasav, veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum".

Umimmay delo yeachel et besaro" – lehecha dishchato achar shennigmar dino, sheasur baachila? ema dehecha dishchato leachar shennigmar dino – shere baachila hu; vehay "lo yeachel et besaro" – lehecha desakleh miskal, deasur bahanaa hu – kidrabbi avahu,
Deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: kol makom shenneemar "lo yochal"; "lo tochal"; "lo tochlu" – echad issur achila veechad issur hanaa bammashma,
Ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela – lagger bintina, velannochri bimchira!

Amri: hane mille hecha denafek leh issur achila veissur hanaa mikkera – millo yochal"; aval hacha, deissur achila missakol yissakel" nafka, i salka datach hay "lo yeachel et besaro" issur hanaa hu, nichtov rachamana: "lo yehane", i name "lo yeachel"; "et besaro" lema li? deaf al gav deavdeh keen basar, deshachteh – asur.
Matkef la mar zutera: ema hane mille
b: Hecha devadak tzur veshachat bo – deavdeh keen sekila, aval hecha deshachteh besakkin – la!
Amri: attu sakkin ketiva beorayyta? vehatnan: hashshochet bemaggal yad, betzor uvekane – shechitato keshera.

Vehasheta denafka leh issur achila veissur hanaa millo yeachel et besaro", "baal hashshor naki" lema li? lahanaat oro. desalka datach amena: besaro hu deasur bahanaa, oro nishtere bahanaa; kamashma lan "baal hashshor naki".
Ulehanach tannae demappeki leh lehay "baal hashshor naki" lidrasha acharina [kidvaenan lememar kamman], hanaat oro mena lehu?
Nafka lehu meet besaro" – et hattafel livsaro, may nihu – oro.
Vehay tanna – "et" la daresh.

Kidtanya: shimon haamsoni, veamri la nechemya haamsoni, haya doresh kol "ettin" shebbattora. kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira", perash. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kol "ettin" sheddarashta – ma tehe alehen? amar lahem: keshem shekkibbalti sachar al hadderisha, kach kibbalti sachar al happerisha.
Ad shebba rabbi akiva, velimmed: "et Adonai elohecha tira" – lerabbot talmide chachamim.
Tanu rabbanan: "uvaal hashshor naki" – rabbi eliezer omer: naki mechatzi chofer.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: vahalo hu atzmo en mishtallem ella miggufo, "haviehu levet din, vishallem lach"!
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: kach ani beenecha, sheddini baze shechayyayv mita? en dini ella keshehemit et haadam al pi ed echad, o al pi vealim.
Al pi vealim?! mode biknas hu!
Kasavar kufera – kappara.

Tanya iddach, amar lo rabbi eliezer: akiva, kach ani beenecha, sheddini baze shechayyayv mita? en dini ella bemitkavvevn laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam; legoy veharag yisrael; linfalim veharag ben kayyayma.
He amar leh beresha? rav kahana mishshemeh derava amar: "mitkavvevn" amar leh beresha. rav tavyome mishshemeh derava amar: "hemit" amar leh beresha.
Rav kahana mishshemeh derava amar "mitkavvevn" amar leh beresha – mashal letzayyad sheshshole dagim min hayyam,

a: Mashkach ravreve – shakel, zutere – shakel.
Rav tavyome mishshemeh derava amar "hemit" amar leh beresha – mashal letzayyayd sheshshole dagim min hayyam, mashkach zutere – shakel, mashkach ravreve – shade zutere veshakel ravreve.
Tanya iddach: "baal hashshor naki" – rabbi yose haggelili omer: naki middeme veladot.
Amar lo rabbi akiva, hare hu omer: "ki yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha" – anashim, velo shevavrim.
Shappir kaamar rabbi akiva!

Amar rav ulla bereh derav idi: itzterich, salka datach amena: anashim – velo shevavrim haddomin laanashim; ma anashim muadin – af shevavrim muadin, ha tam – michayyayv; ketav rachamana "baal hashshor naki" – defatur.
Amar rava: yatztziva beara, vegiyyora bishme shemayya?!

Ella amar rava: itzterich, salka datach amena: anashim – velo shevavrim haddomin laanashim; ma anashim muadin – af shevavrim muadin, vekal vachomer letammin diftiri; hadar ketav rachamana "baal hashshor naki" – tam patur, umuad chayyayv.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, gabbe boshet name nema hachi: anashim – velo shevavrim haddomin laanashim; ma anashim muadin – af shevavrim muadin, vekal vachomer letammin diftiri; hadar ketav rachamana "baal hashshor naki" – tam patur, umuad chayyayv!
Vechi tema hachi name, i hachi, litne: "baal hashshor naki" – rabbi yose haggelili omer: patur middeme veladot umibboshet!

Ella abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: anashim – en ason beishsha yeanshu, yesh ason baishsha lo yeanshu. velo shevavrim – deaf al gav deyesh ason, yeanshu. hadar ketav rachamana "baal hashshor naki" – defatur.
Matkef la rav adda bar ahava: attu beason talya milleta? bechavvavna talya milleta!

Ella amar rav adda bar ahava: anashim – ki nitkavvenu ze laze, af al gav sheyyesh ason baishsha, yeanshu; ki nitkavvenu laishsha atzmah, lo yeanshu. velo shevavrim – daafillu nitkavvenu laishsha atzmah, "yeanshu". ketav rachamana "baal hashshor naki" – diftiri.
Vechen ki ata rav chaggay middaroma, ata veayyti matnita bideh kevoteh derav adda bar ahava.
Tanya iddach: "baal hashshor naki" – rabbi akiva omer: naki middeme eved.
b: Venema rabbi akiva lenafsheh – vahalo atzmo en mishtallem ella miggufo, haviehu levet din vishallem lach!
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: keshekkadam bealav ushechato; mahu detema: lishtallam minneh; ka mashma lan, hoil uvar ketala hu, af al gav deshachteh – la lishtallam minneh.
I hachi, lerabbi eliezer name – keshekkadam ushechato!
Hachi name; vesavar: dilma it leh tama acharina daadif mehay, venema leh.

Verabbi eliezer name – lishanne leh shekkadam ushechato! amar lach: hatam hu denitkavvevn laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, deshor lav bar ketala hu kelal; desalka datach amena nichayyayv – itzterich kera lemaote; aval hacha, demeikkara bar ketala hava – la tzerich kera, af al gav deshachteh.
Ulerabbi akiva name, vadday hachi hava!

Ella amar rav assi: hay milleta – mippi degavra rabba shemia li, umannu – rabbi yose berabbi chanina; salka datach amena, hoil veamar rabbi akiva: af tam shechaval baadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, mishtallam name [deme eved] mealiyyay; ketav rachamana "baal hashshor naki".

Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi: veha tavreh rabbi akiva ligzizeh – detanya, rabbi akiva omer: yachol yeshallem min haaliyyay – talmud lomar: "kammishpat hazze yease lo" – miggufo meshallem, veeno meshallem min haaliyyay!

Ella amar rava: itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil umachmirani beeved yoter mibben chorin, shebben chorin yafe sela – noten sela, sheloshim – noten sheloshim, veeved yafe sela – noten sheloshim; mishtallam name deme eved min haaliyyay; ketav rachamana: "baal hashshor naki".
Tanya kevateh derava: "baal hashshor naki" – rabbi akiva omer: naki middeme eved.
Vahalo din hu – hoil vechayyayv beeved vechayyayv beven chorin; ma keshechiyyev beven chorin – chalakta bo ben tam lemuad, af keshechiyyev beeved – nachlok bo ben tam lemuad!
Veod, kal vachomer – uma ben chorin, shennoten kol shovvyo, chalakta bo ben tam lemuad; eved, sheeno noten ella sheloshim, eno din shennachlok bo ben tam lemuad?

Lo, machmirani beeved yoter mibben chorin; shebben chorin yafe sela – noten sela, sheloshim – noten sheloshim; veeved yafe sela – noten sheloshim, yachol yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "baal hashshor naki" – naki middeme eved.
Tanu rabbanan: "vehemit ish o ishsha" – amar rabbi akiva: vechi ma ba ze lelammedenu? im lechayyev al haishsha kaish – hare kevar neemar: "ki yiggach shor et ish o et ishsha"!
Ella lehakkish ishsha leish, ma ish – nezakav leyorshav, af ishsha – nezakeha leyorsheha.
Vesavar rabbi akiva: la yaret la baal? vehatanya: "veyarash otah" – mikkan shehabbaal yoresh et ishto, divre rabbi akiva!
Amar resh lakish: lo amar ella bechofer – hoil veen mishtallem ella leachar mita, vehave leh rauy, veen habbaal notel barauy kivmuchezak.
May tama? amar kera: "vehemit ish o ishsha, hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat. im kofer yushat alav".
Uvinzakin lo amar rabbi akiva?
Vehatanya: hikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha – noten nezek vatzaar laishsha, udeme veladot labbaal. en habbaal – noten leyorshav, en haishsha – notenet leyorsheha. hayta shifcha venishtachrera,
